    @media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){*{animation-duration:.01ms!important;transition:none!important;scroll-behavior:auto!important}.spin{animation:none!important}}
    /* Keep source and destination setup in the order music moves. */
    .spotify-settings { order: -1; }
    .sync-library { margin-top: 14px; }
    import { useEffect, useRef, useState, type ReactNode } from 'react';
    import { ArrowRight, ArrowRightLeft, ArrowUpRight, Check, CheckCircle2, ChevronLeft, ChevronRight, Clock3, Download, ExternalLink, FileJson, Headphones, Heart, Library, ListMusic, LoaderCircle, LockKeyhole, Menu, Music2, Pause, Play, Plus, Search, Settings2, ShieldCheck, Sparkles, Upload, X, CircleAlert, LayoutDashboard, ScanSearch, Disc3, UsersRound, RefreshCw } from 'lucide-react';
    import { api, setCsrf } from './api.js';
    import type { Candidate, Collection, ConnectionStatus, EntityView, Job, Page, TransferSelection } from '../shared/types.js';
    
    type Screen = 'overview' | 'library' | 'review' | 'history' | 'transfers' | 'settings';
    type Overview = { counts: Record<string, number>; imports: { id: string; name: string; created: string; stats: { warnings: string[]; playlists: number; songs: number; history: number } }[]; jobs: Job[] };
    const number = (value = 0) => new Intl.NumberFormat().format(value);
    const duration = (ms = 0) => ms >= 3600000 ? `${(ms / 3600000).toFixed(1)} hr` : `${Math.round(ms / 60000)} min`;
    const date = (value: string) => new Date(value).toLocaleDateString(undefined, { day: 'numeric', month: 'short', year: 'numeric' });
    const active = (job: Job) => ['queued', 'running'].includes(job.status);
    const errorMessage = (error: unknown) => error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Something went wrong. Try again.';
    
    function Brand({ small = false }: { small?: boolean }) { return <div className={`brand ${small ? 'small' : ''}`}><span className="brand-mark"><ArrowRightLeft size={21}/></span><span>encore<span className="brand-period">.</span></span></div>; }
    function Spinner() { return <LoaderCircle size={17} className="spin"/>; }
    function Badge({ status }: { status: string }) { return <span className={`badge ${status}`}>{status.replaceAll('_', ' ')}</span>; }
    function Empty({ icon, title, children }: { icon: ReactNode; title: string; children: ReactNode }) { return <div className="empty"><div className="empty-icon">{icon}</div><h3>{title}</h3><p>{children}</p></div>; }
    function Modal({ title, children, onClose }: { title: string; children: ReactNode; onClose: () => void }) {
      const ref = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
      const closeRef = useRef(onClose); closeRef.current = onClose;
      useEffect(() => {
        const previous = document.activeElement as HTMLElement; ref.current?.focus();
        const key = (event: KeyboardEvent) => {
          if (event.key === 'Escape') closeRef.current();
          if (event.key === 'Tab') {
            const items = [...(ref.current?.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>('button:not(:disabled),input,textarea,select,a[href]') || [])];
            if (!items.length) { event.preventDefault(); return; }
            if (event.shiftKey && document.activeElement === items[0]) { event.preventDefault(); items.at(-1)?.focus(); }
            else if (!event.shiftKey && document.activeElement === items.at(-1)) { event.preventDefault(); items[0].focus(); }
          }
        }; document.addEventListener('keydown', key); return () => { document.removeEventListener('keydown', key); previous?.focus(); };
      }, []);
      return <div className="modal-backdrop" onMouseDown={e => { if (e.target === e.currentTarget) onClose(); }}><div className="modal" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-label={title} tabIndex={-1} ref={ref}><div className="modal-heading"><h2>{title}</h2><button className="icon-button" aria-label="Close dialog" onClick={onClose}><X size={20}/></button></div>{children}</div></div>;
    }
    function Pager({ page, total, size, change }: { page: number; total: number; size: number; change: (value: number) => void }) {
      if (!total) return null;
      return <div className="pager"><span>{number((page - 1) * size + 1)}â€“{number(Math.min(page * size, total))} of {number(total)}</span><div><button className="icon-button" aria-label="Previous page" disabled={page === 1} onClick={() => change(page - 1)}><ChevronLeft size={18}/></button><button className="icon-button" aria-label="Next page" disabled={page * size >= total} onClick={() => change(page + 1)}><ChevronRight size={18}/></button></div></div>;
    }
    function Cover({ id, name, small = false }: { id: string; name: string; small?: boolean }) {
      const theme = parseInt(id.slice(0, 2), 16) % 6 || 0;
      return <div className={`cover theme-${theme} ${small ? 'cover-small' : ''}`} aria-hidden="true"><div className="cover-orbit"/><span>{name.slice(0, 1).toUpperCase()}</span><Music2 size={small ? 15 : 25}/></div>;
    }
    
    export default function App() {
      const [ready, setReady] = useState(false);
      const [error, setError] = useState('');
      const opening = useRef<Promise<{ csrf: string }> | undefined>(undefined);
      useEffect(() => {
        opening.current ??= api('/api/auth/status');
        opening.current.then(data => { setCsrf(data.csrf); setReady(true); }).catch(e => setError(errorMessage(e)));
      }, []);
      if (!ready) return <div className="boot"><Brand/><p>{error || <><Spinner/> Opening your music workspaceâ€¦</>}</p>{error && <button className="btn" onClick={() => location.reload()}>Try again</button>}</div>;
      return <Workspace/>;
    }
    
    function Workspace() {
      const [screen, setScreen] = useState<Screen>('overview'); const [mobileNav, setMobileNav] = useState(false);
      const [overview, setOverview] = useState<Overview>(); const [connections, setConnections] = useState<ConnectionStatus>(); const [collections, setCollections] = useState<Collection[]>([]);
      const [selected, setSelected] = useState<Set<string>>(new Set()); const known = useRef(new Set<string>());
      const [selectionFlags, setSelectionFlags] = useState({ likes: true, songs: true, albums: true, artists: true }); const [favorites, setFavorites] = useState<Set<string>>(new Set());
      const [notice, setNotice] = useState<{ text: string; error?: boolean }>(); const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false); const [refreshVersion, setRefreshVersion] = useState(0);
      const input = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null); const refreshBusy = useRef(false);
      const refresh = async () => {
        if (refreshBusy.current) return; refreshBusy.current = true;
        const results = await Promise.allSettled([api<Overview>('/api/overview'), api<ConnectionStatus>('/api/connections'), api<Collection[]>('/api/library/collections')]);
        if (results[0].status === 'fulfilled') setOverview(results[0].value);
        if (results[1].status === 'fulfilled') setConnections(results[1].value);
        if (results[2].status === 'fulfilled') {
          const list = results[2].value; setCollections(list);
          const added = list.filter(c => !known.current.has(c.id) && !c.inaccessible).map(c => c.id);
          setSelected(old => { const next = new Set([...old].filter(id => list.some(c => c.id === id))); for (const id of added) next.add(id); return next; });
          known.current = new Set(list.map(c => c.id));
        }
        for (const result of results) if (result.status === 'rejected') { setNotice({ text: errorMessage(result.reason), error: true }); break; }
        refreshBusy.current = false;
      };
      useEffect(() => { void refresh(); const timer = setInterval(() => void refresh(), 2500); return () => clearInterval(timer); }, []);
      useEffect(() => {
        const state = new URLSearchParams(location.search).get('spotify');
        if (state) { setScreen('settings'); setNotice({ text: state === 'connected' ? 'Spotify connected. Import your current library below.' : 'Spotify did not connect. Check your developer app or use an export file.', error: state !== 'connected' }); history.replaceState(null, '', location.pathname); }
      }, []);
      const run = async (fn: () => Promise<unknown>, message?: string) => {
        setBusy(true); try { await fn(); if (message) setNotice({ text: message }); setRefreshVersion(v => v + 1); await refresh(); }
        catch (error) { setNotice({ text: errorMessage(error), error: true }); } finally { setBusy(false); }
      };
      const importFiles = async (files: FileList | File[]) => {
        await run(async () => { const messages: string[] = [];
          for (const file of Array.from(files)) {
            const form = new FormData(); form.append('file', file); const result = await api('/api/imports', { method: 'POST', body: form });
            messages.push(result.duplicate ? `${file.name} was already imported.` : `${file.name}: ${result.stats.playlists} playlists, ${result.stats.songs} saved songs, ${number(result.stats.history)} listening events imported.`);
            if (result.stats.warnings.length) messages.push(...result.stats.warnings);
          } setNotice({ text: messages.join(' ') });
        });
      };
      const selection: TransferSelection = { collectionIds: [...selected], ...selectionFlags, favoriteIds: [...favorites] };
      const matching = overview?.jobs.some(job => job.kind === 'match' && active(job));
      const navigate = (value: Screen) => { setScreen(value); setMobileNav(false); };
      const nav: { id: Screen; name: string; icon: ReactNode; count?: number }[] = [
        { id: 'overview', name: 'Overview', icon: <LayoutDashboard size={19}/> }, { id: 'library', name: 'Your collection', icon: <Library size={19}/> },
        { id: 'review', name: 'Review matches', icon: <ScanSearch size={19}/>, count: overview?.counts.review }, { id: 'history', name: 'Listening history', icon: <Clock3 size={19}/> },
        { id: 'transfers', name: 'Transfers', icon: <ArrowRightLeft size={19}/> },
      ];
      const title = nav.find(n => n.id === screen)?.name || 'Connections & settings';
      return <div className="app-shell"><aside className={`sidebar ${mobileNav ? 'open' : ''}`}><Brand/><div className="workspace-label">YOUR WORKSPACE</div><nav>{nav.map(item => <button key={item.id} className={`nav-item ${screen === item.id ? 'selected' : ''}`} onClick={() => navigate(item.id)}>{item.icon}<span>{item.name}</span>{!!item.count && <span className="nav-count">{item.count}</span>}</button>)}</nav><div className="sidebar-bottom"><div className="private-note"><ShieldCheck size={21}/><div><strong>Your music. Your server.</strong><span>Private by design.</span></div></div><button className={`nav-item ${screen === 'settings' ? 'selected' : ''}`} onClick={() => navigate('settings')}><Settings2 size={19}/><span>Connections & settings</span></button><div className="owner"><span className="avatar">ME</span><div><strong>My workspace</strong><span>Local music workspace</span></div></div></div></aside>{mobileNav && <button className="nav-backdrop" aria-label="Close navigation" onClick={() => setMobileNav(false)}/>}
        <div className="main-shell"><header className="topbar"><div><button className="icon-button mobile-menu" aria-label="Open navigation" onClick={() => setMobileNav(true)}><Menu size={22}/></button><span className="breadcrumb">Workspace <ChevronRight size={13}/> <strong>{title}</strong></span></div><div className="topbar-right"><span className="local-pill"><span/> Self-hosted workspace</span><a className="icon-button" href="/api/export?format=json&type=library" aria-label="Download library backup"><Download size={18}/></a></div></header>
          <main>{!overview || !connections ? <div className="loading"><Spinner/> Loading your collectionâ€¦</div> : <>
            {screen === 'overview' && <OverviewScreen overview={overview} connections={connections} collections={collections} busy={busy} onImport={() => input.current?.click()} onDrop={importFiles} navigate={navigate} onSync={() => void run(async () => { await api('/api/imports/spotify', { method: 'POST' }); navigate('transfers'); }, 'Spotify import queued.')}/>}
            {screen === 'library' && <LibraryScreen collections={collections} selected={selected} setSelected={setSelected} flags={selectionFlags} setFlags={setSelectionFlags} overview={overview} refreshVersion={refreshVersion} run={run} onImport={() => input.current?.click()}/>}
            {screen === 'review' && <ReviewScreen refreshVersion={refreshVersion} run={run} matching={!!matching} busy={busy} onMatch={() => void run(async () => { await api('/api/matches', { method: 'POST', body: selection }); navigate('transfers'); }, 'Matching queued. Strong matches will be selected automatically.')}/>}
            {screen === 'history' && <HistoryScreen refreshVersion={refreshVersion} run={run} favorites={favorites} setFavorites={setFavorites} navigate={navigate}/>}
            {screen === 'transfers' && <TransfersScreen refreshVersion={refreshVersion} run={run}/>}
            {screen === 'settings' && <SettingsScreen connections={connections} run={run} busy={busy} onImport={() => input.current?.click()} navigate={navigate}/>}
          </>}</main>
          {overview && connections && ['overview', 'library', 'review', 'history'].includes(screen) && <div className="transfer-bar"><div className="transfer-selection"><span className="selection-icon"><ListMusic size={21}/></span><div><strong>{selected.size} playlists selected</strong><span>{[selectionFlags.likes && 'Likes', selectionFlags.songs && 'Saved songs', selectionFlags.albums && 'Albums', selectionFlags.artists && 'Artists', favorites.size > 0 && `${favorites.size} extra favorites`].filter(Boolean).join(' Â· ') || 'Playlist transfer only'}</span></div></div><div className="transfer-actions"><button className="btn secondary" disabled={busy || matching || !connections.youtube.connected} onClick={() => void run(async () => { await api('/api/matches', { method: 'POST', body: selection }); navigate('transfers'); }, 'Catalog matching queued.')}><ScanSearch size={17}/> Find matches</button><button className="btn primary" disabled={busy || !overview.counts.playlists && !overview.counts.likes && !overview.counts.albums && !overview.counts.artists} onClick={() => { if (!connections.youtube.connected) { navigate('settings'); return; } void run(async () => { await api('/api/transfers', { method: 'POST', body: selection }); navigate('transfers'); }, 'Transfer queued. Your playlists go first.'); }}>{busy ? <Spinner/> : <ArrowRight size={18}/>} {connections.youtube.connected ? 'Start transfer' : 'Connect YouTube Music'}</button></div></div>}
        </div><input ref={input} className="sr-only" type="file" accept=".zip,.json" multiple aria-label="Upload Spotify data" onChange={e => { if (e.target.files) void importFiles(e.target.files); e.target.value = ''; }}/>{notice && <div className={`toast ${notice.error ? 'error' : ''}`} role={notice.error ? 'alert' : 'status'}>{notice.error ? <CircleAlert size={20}/> : <CheckCircle2 size={20}/>}<span>{notice.text}</span><button className="icon-button" aria-label="Dismiss notification" onClick={() => setNotice(undefined)}><X size={17}/></button></div>}
      </div>;
    }
    function OverviewScreen({ overview, connections, collections, busy, onImport, onDrop, navigate, onSync }: { overview: Overview; connections: ConnectionStatus; collections: Collection[]; busy: boolean; onImport: () => void; onDrop: (files: FileList) => Promise<void>; navigate: (screen: Screen) => void; onSync: () => void }) {
      const [dragging, setDragging] = useState(false); const counts = overview.counts;
      const stats = [{ title: 'Playlists', value: counts.playlists, icon: <ListMusic/>, detail: 'Ready to take with you' }, { title: 'Liked songs', value: counts.likes, icon: <Heart/>, detail: 'Your favorites, preserved' }, { title: 'Saved albums', value: counts.albums, icon: <Disc3/>, detail: `${number(counts.artists)} followed artists` }, { title: 'Listening memories', value: counts.history, icon: <Headphones/>, detail: 'Archived on your server' }];
      const hasData = !!(counts.playlists || counts.songs || counts.albums || counts.artists);
      const stages = [{ name: 'Import your music', complete: hasData }, { name: 'Connect accounts', complete: connections.youtube.connected }, { name: 'Choose collections', complete: hasData }, { name: 'Review matches', complete: counts.matched > 0 && !counts.review }, { name: 'Make the move', complete: overview.jobs.some(j => j.kind === 'transfer' && j.status === 'completed') }];
      return <><div className="page-heading"><div><span className="eyebrow">YOUR MUSIC, MOVING FORWARD</span><h1>A new home. Same soundtrack.</h1><p>Bring every playlist and favorite along for the ride.</p></div><button className="btn secondary" onClick={() => navigate('library')}><Library size={17}/> View collection</button></div>
        <section className="hero"><div className="hero-copy"><span className="hero-label"><span/> SPOTIFY â†’ YOUTUBE MUSIC</span><h2>Good music.<br/><em>New possibilities.</em></h2><p>Years of finding your sound shouldn't get left behind.<br/>Move your collection, one perfectly matched song at a time.</p><button className="btn primary" disabled={busy} onClick={() => connections.spotify.connected ? onSync() : navigate('settings')}>{busy ? <Spinner/> : <Music2 size={17}/>} {connections.spotify.connected ? 'Import from Spotify' : 'Connect Spotify'}<ArrowUpRight size={17}/></button><span className="hero-footnote"><CheckCircle2 size={13}/> Works with free Spotify and YouTube Music accounts.</span></div><div className="hero-art" aria-hidden="true"><div className="art-grid"/><div className="record record-back"><span/></div><div className="record record-front"><div className="record-label"><Music2 size={28}/><span>YOUR COLLECTION</span></div></div><div className="floating-service spotify"><Music2 size={30}/></div><div className="floating-service youtube"><Play size={25} fill="currentColor"/></div><span className="art-caption">THE NEXT TRACK STARTS HERE</span></div></section>
        <div className="stats-grid">{stats.map(stat => <section className="stat-card" key={stat.title}><div className="stat-top"><span>{stat.title}</span>{stat.icon}</div><strong>{number(stat.value)}</strong><p>{stat.detail}</p></section>)}</div>
        <section className="journey-panel"><div className="section-heading"><div><h2>Your move, step by step</h2><p>A little setup. A lot of music.</p></div><span className="tag">ONE-WAY TRANSFER</span></div><div className="steps">{stages.map((stage, index) => <div className={`step ${stage.complete ? 'complete' : ''}`} key={stage.name}><span className="step-number">{stage.complete ? <Check size={15}/> : String(index + 1).padStart(2, '0')}</span><strong>{stage.name}</strong>{index < stages.length - 1 && <span className="step-line"/>}</div>)}</div></section>
        <div className="overview-bottom"><section className={`import-card ${dragging ? 'dragging' : ''}`} onDragOver={e => { e.preventDefault(); setDragging(true); }} onDragLeave={() => setDragging(false)} onDrop={e => { e.preventDefault(); setDragging(false); if (!busy) void onDrop(e.dataTransfer.files); }}><span className="import-symbol">{busy ? <Spinner/> : <FileJson size={27}/>}</span><h3>{busy ? 'Making room for your musicâ€¦' : 'Your Spotify export goes here'}</h3><p>Drop an Account data ZIP or JSON file.<br/>Add Extended streaming history whenever you're ready.</p><button className="btn secondary" onClick={onImport} disabled={busy}>Browse files <Plus size={16}/></button><span className="fine-print">ZIP / JSON Â· Up to 512 MB per upload</span></section><section className="connection-panel"><div className="section-heading"><h2>Connected accounts</h2><button className="text-button" onClick={() => navigate('settings')}>Manage <ArrowUpRight size={14}/></button></div><div className="account-row"><span className="service-icon spotify"><Music2 size={22}/></span><div><strong>Spotify</strong><span>{connections.spotify.account || (hasData ? 'Data archive imported' : 'Connect your Free or Premium account')}</span></div><Badge status={connections.spotify.connected || hasData ? 'connected' : 'not_connected'}/></div><div className="account-row"><span className="service-icon youtube"><Play size={19} fill="currentColor"/></span><div><strong>YouTube Music</strong><span>{connections.youtube.account || 'Connect your destination account'}</span></div><Badge status={connections.youtube.connected ? 'connected' : 'not_connected'}/></div><div className="connection-note"><ShieldCheck size={18}/><p>Account credentials are encrypted on your server. You control every transfer.</p></div>{collections.length > 0 && <div className="recent-import"><span>LATEST IN YOUR COLLECTION</span><strong><ListMusic size={16}/>{collections.at(-1)?.name}</strong></div>}</section></div>
        {overview.imports.some(i => i.stats.warnings.length) && <details className="import-warnings"><summary><CircleAlert size={16}/> Import notes and unsupported records</summary>{overview.imports.slice(0, 5).flatMap(i => i.stats.warnings.map((warning, index) => <p key={`${i.id}-${index}`}>{warning}</p>))}</details>}
      </>;
    }
    
    function useData<T>(path: string, version = 0) {
      const [data, setData] = useState<T>(); const [error, setError] = useState('');
      useEffect(() => { const controller = new AbortController(); setError(''); api<T>(path, { signal: controller.signal }).then(setData).catch(e => { if (!controller.signal.aborted) setError(errorMessage(e)); }); return () => controller.abort(); }, [path, version]);
      return { data, error };
    }
    function LibraryScreen({ collections, selected, setSelected, flags, setFlags, overview, refreshVersion, run, onImport }: { collections: Collection[]; selected: Set<string>; setSelected: (value: Set<string>) => void; flags: { likes: boolean; songs: boolean; albums: boolean; artists: boolean }; setFlags: (value: typeof flags) => void; overview: Overview; refreshVersion: number; run: (fn: () => Promise<unknown>, message?: string) => Promise<void>; onImport: () => void }) {
      const [tab, setTab] = useState('playlists'); const [search, setSearch] = useState(''); const [page, setPage] = useState(1); const [preview, setPreview] = useState<Collection>();
      const kind = tab === 'albums' ? 'album' : tab === 'artists' ? 'artist' : 'song';
      const { data, error } = useData<Page<EntityView>>(`/api/library/entities?kind=${kind}&${tab === 'likes' ? 'liked=true' : tab === 'artists' ? 'followed=true' : 'saved=true'}&q=${encodeURIComponent(search)}&page=${page}`, refreshVersion);
      const filtered = collections.filter(c => c.name.toLowerCase().includes(search.toLowerCase()));
      const toggle = (id: string) => { const next = new Set(selected); if (next.has(id)) next.delete(id); else next.add(id); setSelected(next); };
      return <><div className="page-heading"><div><span className="eyebrow">THE COLLECTION YOU'VE BUILT</span><h1>All your favorites, together.</h1><p>Choose what comes with you. Your original Spotify collection stays intact.</p></div><button className="btn secondary" onClick={onImport}><Plus size={17}/> Import music</button></div><div className="library-options">{(['likes', 'songs', 'albums', 'artists'] as const).map(key => <label className="check-option" key={key}><input type="checkbox" checked={flags[key]} onChange={e => setFlags({ ...flags, [key]: e.target.checked })}/>{({ likes: 'Transfer native likes', songs: 'Save songs to library', albums: 'Save albums', artists: 'Follow artists' })[key]}</label>)}</div><div className="toolbar"><div className="tabs">{[['playlists', 'Playlists', overview.counts.playlists], ['likes', 'Liked songs', overview.counts.likes], ['songs', 'Saved songs', null], ['albums', 'Albums', overview.counts.albums], ['artists', 'Artists', overview.counts.artists]].map(([id, label, count]) => <button key={id} className={tab === id ? 'active' : ''} onClick={() => { setTab(String(id)); setPage(1); setSearch(''); }}>{label}{count !== null && <span>{number(Number(count))}</span>}</button>)}</div><label className="search-field"><Search size={17}/><input aria-label="Search collection" placeholder="Search your collection" value={search} onChange={e => { setSearch(e.target.value); setPage(1); }}/></label></div>
        {tab === 'playlists' ? <><div className="list-heading"><label className="check-option"><input type="checkbox" checked={filtered.filter(c => !c.inaccessible).length > 0 && filtered.filter(c => !c.inaccessible).every(c => selected.has(c.id))} onChange={e => { const next = new Set(selected); filtered.filter(c => !c.inaccessible).forEach(c => e.target.checked ? next.add(c.id) : next.delete(c.id)); setSelected(next); }}/> Select all visible playlists</label><span>{number(selected.size)} selected</span></div>{filtered.length ? <div className="playlist-grid">{filtered.map(collection => <article className={`playlist-card ${selected.has(collection.id) ? 'checked' : ''}`} key={collection.id}><div className="playlist-art"><Cover id={collection.id} name={collection.name}/><label className="cover-checkbox"><input type="checkbox" aria-label={`Transfer ${collection.name}`} disabled={collection.inaccessible} checked={selected.has(collection.id)} onChange={() => toggle(collection.id)}/></label><button className="preview-button" aria-label={`Preview ${collection.name}`} onClick={() => setPreview(collection)}><ListMusic size={20}/></button></div><div className="playlist-info"><span className="eyebrow">{collection.generated ? 'FROM YOUR HISTORY' : 'SPOTIFY PLAYLIST'}</span><h3 title={collection.name}>{collection.name}</h3><p>{collection.inaccessible ?     import { readFileSync, writeFileSync } from 'node:fs';
    import postcss from 'postcss';
    
    const sheet = postcss.parse(readFileSync('src/styles.css', 'utf8'));
    sheet.walkRules(rule => {
      if (/\.(?:login-|service-journey|privacy-line|lock-mark)/.test(rule.selector)) rule.remove();
    });
    
    // Retain component and breakpoint behavior while removing the old green cast.
    sheet.walkDecls(declaration => {
      declaration.value = declaration.value.replace(/#([\da-f]{3,8})\b/gi, (_, input) => {
        let hex = input;
        if (hex.length === 3 || hex.length === 4) hex = [...hex].map(n => n + n).join('');
        if (![6, 8].includes(hex.length)) return `#${input}`;
        const gray = Math.round(parseInt(hex.slice(0, 2), 16) * .2126 + parseInt(hex.slice(2, 4), 16) * .7152 + parseInt(hex.slice(4, 6), 16) * .0722).toString(16).padStart(2, '0');
        return `#${gray.repeat(3)}${hex.slice(6)}`;
      }).replaceAll('var(--lime)', 'var(--accent)');
      if (declaration.prop === '--lime') declaration.prop = '--accent';
      if (declaration.prop === 'font-size' && /^\d+(\.\d+)?px$/.test(declaration.value)) {
        const size = parseFloat(declaration.value);
        if (size < 12) declaration.value = `${size < 8 ? 9 : size + 1}px`;
      }
    });
    
    function style(selector, values) {
      let rule = sheet.nodes.find(node => node.type === 'rule' && node.selector === selector);
      if (!rule) { rule = postcss.rule({ selector }); sheet.append(rule); }
      for (const [prop, value] of Object.entries(values)) {
        const existing = rule.nodes.find(node => node.type === 'decl' && node.prop === prop);
        if (existing) existing.value = value; else rule.append({ prop, value });
      }
    }

      .hero-copy p br::after { content: ' '; }

      .hero-footnote svg { margin-top: 2px; flex-shrink: 0; }
      .hero .btn { font-size: 12px; padding: 11px 14px; }
      .hero-label { font-size: 8px; }

      .settings-card { padding: 22px; }

      .job-heading div>span { font-size: 10px; }
      .job-counts { font-size: 10px; }
      .settings-card-heading .badge { font-size: 9px; }
    }
    @media (max-width: 540px) {
      .hero { display: block; min-height: 326px; }
      .hero-copy { position: relative; padding: 27px 24px; }
      .hero h2 { font-size: 38px; letter-spacing: -1.65px; }
      .hero p { max-width: 280px; font-size: 12px; }
      .hero-copy p br { display: initial; }
      .hero-art { position: absolute; inset: 0 -65px 0 auto; width: 185px; min-height: 0; opacity: .18; pointer-events: none; }
      .hero-art .record-front { top: 84px; right: -25px; width: 185px; height: 185px; }
      .hero-art .record-back { top: 43px; right: 40px; }
      .hero-art .floating-service { display: none; }
      .hero-footnote { max-width: 260px; }
      .page-heading { flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 17px; }
      .page-heading h1 { font-size: 29px; }
      .page-heading>.btn { font-size: 11px; }
      .local-pill { font-size: 9px; }
      .breadcrumb { font-size: 10px; }
      .stat-top { font-size: 11px; }
      .stat-card { min-width: 0; padding: 18px 16px; }
      .stat-card>strong { font-size: 29px; }
      .journey-panel { padding: 22px 20px; }
      .journey-panel .section-heading { flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 13px; }
      .tag { font-size: 8px; }
      .transfer-selection { width: 100%; }
      .transfer-selection div>span { font-size: 10px; }
      .transfer-actions { width: 100%; }
      .transfer-actions .btn { flex: 1; padding: 10px; }
      .settings-card-heading { flex-wrap: wrap; }
      .settings-card-heading>div { min-width: 150px; }
      .settings-card-heading .badge { margin-left: 50px; }
      .form-row { flex-direction: column; }
    }
    `));
    
    // Make the stylesheet reviewable instead of retaining the original minified lines.
    sheet.walk(node => { node.raws.before = node.type === 'decl' ? '\n  ' : '\n\n'; if (node.type === 'rule' || node.type === 'atrule') node.raws.after = '\n'; });
    writeFileSync('src/styles.css', sheet.toString().trim() + '\n');
    let html = readFileSync('index.html', 'utf8');
    html = html.replace('content="#0c1013"', 'content="#09090b"');
    writeFileSync('index.html', html);

    # Vercel React Best Practices
    
    Comprehensive performance optimization guide for React and Next.js applications, maintained by Vercel. Contains 70 rules across 8 categories, prioritized by impact to guide automated refactoring and code generation.
    
    ## When to Apply
    
    Reference these guidelines when:
    - Writing new React components or Next.js pages
    - Implementing data fetching (client or server-side)
    - Reviewing code for performance issues
    - Refactoring existing React/Next.js code
    - Optimizing bundle size or load times
    
    ## Rule Categories by Priority
    
    | Priority | Category | Impact | Prefix |
    |----------|----------|--------|--------|
    | 1 | Eliminating Waterfalls | CRITICAL | `async-` |
    | 2 | Bundle Size Optimization | CRITICAL | `bundle-` |
    | 3 | Server-Side Performance | HIGH | `server-` |
    | 4 | Client-Side Data Fetching | MEDIUM-HIGH | `client-` |
    | 5 | Re-render Optimization | MEDIUM | `rerender-` |
    | 6 | Rendering Performance | MEDIUM | `rendering-` |
    | 7 | JavaScript Performance | LOW-MEDIUM | `js-` |
    | 8 | Advanced Patterns | LOW | `advanced-` |
    
    ## Quick Reference
    
    ### 1. Eliminating Waterfalls (CRITICAL)
    
    - `async-cheap-condition-before-await` - Check cheap sync conditions before awaiting flags or remote values
    - `async-defer-await` - Move await into branches where actually used
    - `async-parallel` - Use Promise.all() for independent operations
    - `async-dependencies` - Use better-all for partial dependencies
    - `async-api-routes` - Start promises early, await late in API routes
    - `async-suspense-boundaries` - Use Suspense to stream content
    
    ### 2. Bundle Size Optimization (CRITICAL)
    
    - `bundle-barrel-imports` - Import directly, avoid barrel files
    - `bundle-analyzable-paths` - Prefer statically analyzable import and file-system paths to avoid broad bundles and traces
    - `bundle-dynamic-imports` - Use next/dynamic for heavy components
    - `bundle-defer-third-party` - Load analytics/logging after hydration
    - `bundle-conditional` - Load modules only when feature is activated
    - `bundle-preload` - Preload on hover/focus for perceived speed
    
    ### 3. Server-Side Performance (HIGH)
    
    - `server-auth-actions` - Authenticate server actions like API routes
    - `server-cache-react` - Use React.cache() for per-request deduplication
    - `server-cache-lru` - Use LRU cache for cross-request caching
    - `server-dedup-props` - Avoid duplicate serialization in RSC props
    - `server-hoist-static-io` - Hoist static I/O (fonts, logos) to module level
    - `server-no-shared-module-state` - Avoid module-level mutable request state in RSC/SSR
    - `server-serialization` - Minimize data passed to client components
    - `server-parallel-fetching` - Restructure components to parallelize fetches
    - `server-parallel-nested-fetching` - Chain nested fetches per item in Promise.all
    - `server-after-nonblocking` - Use after() for non-blocking operations
    
    ### 4. Client-Side Data Fetching (MEDIUM-HIGH)
    
    - `client-swr-dedup` - Use SWR for automatic request deduplication
    - `client-event-listeners` - Deduplicate global event listeners
    - `client-passive-event-listeners` - Use passive listeners for scroll
    - `client-localstorage-schema` - Version and minimize localStorage data
    
    ### 5. Re-render Optimization (MEDIUM)
    
    - `rerender-defer-reads` - Don't subscribe to state only used in callbacks
    - `rerender-memo` - Extract expensive work into memoized components
    - `rerender-memo-with-default-value` - Hoist default non-primitive props
    - `rerender-dependencies` - Use primitive dependencies in effects
    - `rerender-derived-state` - Subscribe to derived booleans, not raw values
    - `rerender-derived-state-no-effect` - Derive state during render, not effects
    - `rerender-functional-setstate` - Use functional setState for stable callbacks
    - `rerender-lazy-state-init` - Pass function to useState for expensive values
    - `rerender-simple-expression-in-memo` - Avoid memo for simple primitives
    - `rerender-split-combined-hooks` - Split hooks with independent dependencies
    - `rerender-move-effect-to-event` - Put interaction logic in event handlers
    - `rerender-transitions` - Use startTransition for non-urgent updates
    - `rerender-use-deferred-value` - Defer expensive renders to keep input responsive
    - `rerender-use-ref-transient-values` - Use refs for transient frequent values
    - `rerender-no-inline-components` - Don't define components inside components
    
    ### 6. Rendering Performance (MEDIUM)
    
    - `rendering-animate-svg-wrapper` - Animate div wrapper, not SVG element
    - `rendering-content-visibility` - Use content-visibility for long lists
    - `rendering-hoist-jsx` - Extract static JSX outside components
    - `rendering-svg-precision` - Reduce SVG coordinate precision
    - `rendering-hydration-no-flicker` - Use inline script for client-only data
    - `rendering-hydration-suppress-warning` - Suppress expected mismatches
    - `rendering-activity` - Use Activity component for show/hide
    - `rendering-conditional-render` - Use ternary, not && for conditionals
    - `rendering-usetransition-loading` - Prefer useTransition for loading state
    - `rendering-resource-hints` - Use React DOM resource hints for preloading
    - `rendering-script-defer-async` - Use defer or async on script tags
    
    ### 7. JavaScript Performance (LOW-MEDIUM)
    
    - `js-batch-dom-css` - Group CSS changes via classes or cssText
    - `js-index-maps` - Build Map for repeated lookups
    - `js-cache-property-access` - Cache object properties in loops
    - `js-cache-function-results` - Cache function results in module-level Map
    - `js-cache-storage` - Cache localStorage/sessionStorage reads
    - `js-combine-iterations` - Combine multiple filter/map into one loop
    - `js-length-check-first` - Check array length before expensive comparison
    - `js-early-exit` - Return early from functions
    - `js-hoist-regexp` - Hoist RegExp creation outside loops
    - `js-min-max-loop` - Use loop for min/max instead of sort
    - `js-set-map-lookups` - Use Set/Map for O(1) lookups
    - `js-tosorted-immutable` - Use toSorted() for immutability
    - `js-flatmap-filter` - Use flatMap to map and filter in one pass
    - `js-request-idle-callback` - Defer non-critical work to browser idle time
    
    ### 8. Advanced Patterns (LOW)
    
    - `advanced-effect-event-deps` - Don't put `useEffectEvent` results in effect deps
    - `advanced-event-handler-refs` - Store event handlers in refs
    - `advanced-init-once` - Initialize app once per app load
    - `advanced-use-latest` - useLatest for stable callback refs
    
    ## How to Use
    
    Read individual rule files for detailed explanations and code examples:
    
    ```
    rules/async-parallel.md
    rules/bundle-barrel-imports.md
    ```
    
    Each rule file contains:
    - Brief explanation of why it matters
    - Incorrect code example with explanation

    function Modal({ title, children, onClose }: { title: string; children: ReactNode; onClose: () => void }) {
      const ref = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
      const closeRef = useRef(onClose); closeRef.current = onClose;
      useEffect(() => {
        const previous = document.activeElement as HTMLElement; ref.current?.focus();
        const key = (event: KeyboardEvent) => {
          if (event.key === 'Escape') closeRef.current();
          if (event.key === 'Tab') {
            const items = [...(ref.current?.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>('button:not(:disabled),input,textarea,select,a[href]') || [])];
            if (!items.length) { event.preventDefault(); return; }
            if (event.shiftKey && document.activeElement === items[0]) { event.preventDefault(); items.at(-1)?.focus(); }
            else if (!event.shiftKey && document.activeElement === items.at(-1)) { event.preventDefault(); items[0].focus(); }

            {screen === 'review' && <ReviewScreen refreshVersion={refreshVersion} run={run} matching={!!matching} busy={busy} onMatch={() => void run(async () => { await api('/api/matches', { method: 'POST', body: selection }); navigate('transfers'); }, 'Matching queued. Strong matches will be selected automatically.')}/>}
            {screen === 'history' && <HistoryScreen refreshVersion={refreshVersion} run={run} favorites={favorites} setFavorites={setFavorites} navigate={navigate}/>}
            {screen === 'transfers' && <TransfersScreen refreshVersion={refreshVersion} run={run}/>}
            {screen === 'settings' && <SettingsScreen connections={connections} run={run} busy={busy} onImport={() => input.current?.click()} navigate={navigate}/>}
          </>}</main>
          {overview && connections && ['overview', 'library', 'review', 'history'].includes(screen) && <div className="transfer-bar"><div className="transfer-selection"><span className="selection-icon"><ListMusic size={21}/></span><div><strong>{selected.size} playlists selected</strong><span>{[selectionFlags.likes && 'Likes', selectionFlags.songs && 'Saved songs', selectionFlags.albums && 'Albums', selectionFlags.artists && 'Artists', favorites.size > 0 && `${favorites.size} extra favorites`].filter(Boolean).join(' Â· ') || 'Playlist transfer only'}</span></div></div><div className="transfer-actions"><button className="btn secondary" disabled={busy || matching || !connections.youtube.connected} onClick={() => void run(async () => { await api('/api/matches', { method: 'POST', body: selection }); navigate('transfers'); }, 'Catalog matching queued.')}><ScanSearch size={17}/> Find matches</button><button className="btn primary" disabled={busy || !overview.counts.playlists && !overview.counts.likes && !overview.counts.albums && !overview.counts.artists} onClick={() => { if (!connections.youtube.connected) { navigate('settings'); return; } void run(async () => { await api('/api/transfers', { method: 'POST', body: selection }); navigate('transfers'); }, 'Transfer queued. Your playlists go first.'); }}>{busy ? <Spinner/> : <ArrowRight size={18}/>} {connections.youtube.connected ? 'Start transfer' : 'Connect YouTube Music'}</button></div></div>}
        </div><input ref={input} className="sr-only" type="file" accept=".zip,.json" multiple aria-label="Upload Spotify data" onChange={e => { if (e.target.files) void importFiles(e.target.files); e.target.value = ''; }}/>{notice && <div className={`toast ${notice.error ? 'error' : ''}`} role={notice.error ? 'alert' : 'status'}>{notice.error ? <CircleAlert size={20}/> : <CheckCircle2 size={20}/>}<span>{notice.text}</span><button className="icon-button" aria-label="Dismiss notification" onClick={() => setNotice(undefined)}><X size={17}/></button></div>}
      </div>;
    }
    function OverviewScreen({ overview, connections, collections, busy, onImport, onDrop, navigate, onSync }: { overview: Overview; connections: ConnectionStatus; collections: Collection[]; busy: boolean; onImport: () => void; onDrop: (files: FileList) => Promise<void>; navigate: (screen: Screen) => void; onSync: () => void }) {
      const [dragging, setDragging] = useState(false); const counts = overview.counts;
      const stats = [{ title: 'Playlists', value: counts.playlists, icon: <ListMusic/>, detail: 'Ready to take with you' }, { title: 'Liked songs', value: counts.likes, icon: <Heart/>, detail: 'Your favorites, preserved' }, { title: 'Saved albums', value: counts.albums, icon: <Disc3/>, detail: `${number(counts.artists)} followed artists` }, { title: 'Listening memories', value: counts.history, icon: <Headphones/>, detail: 'Archived on your server' }];
      const hasData = !!(counts.playlists || counts.songs || counts.albums || counts.artists);
      const stages = [{ name: 'Import your music', complete: hasData }, { name: 'Connect accounts', complete: connections.youtube.connected }, { name: 'Choose collections', complete: hasData }, { name: 'Review matches', complete: counts.matched > 0 && !counts.review }, { name: 'Make the move', complete: overview.jobs.some(j => j.kind === 'transfer' && j.status === 'completed') }];
      return <><div className="page-heading"><div><span className="eyebrow">YOUR MUSIC, MOVING FORWARD</span><h1>A new home. Same soundtrack.</h1><p>Bring every playlist and favorite along for the ride.</p></div><button className="btn secondary" onClick={() => navigate('library')}><Library size={17}/> View collection</button></div>
        <section className="hero"><div className="hero-copy"><span className="hero-label"><span/> SPOTIFY â†’ YOUTUBE MUSIC</span><h2>Good music.<br/><em>New possibilities.</em></h2><p>Years of finding your sound shouldn't get left behind.<br/>Move your collection, one perfectly matched song at a time.</p><button className="btn primary" disabled={busy} onClick={() => connections.spotify.connected ? onSync() : navigate('settings')}>{busy ? <Spinner/> : <Music2 size={17}/>} {connections.spotify.connected ? 'Import from Spotify' : 'Connect Spotify'}<ArrowUpRight size={17}/></button><span className="hero-footnote"><CheckCircle2 size={13}/> Works with free Spotify and YouTube Music accounts.</span></div><div className="hero-art" aria-hidden="true"><div className="art-grid"/><div className="record record-back"><span/></div><div className="record record-front"><div className="record-label"><Music2 size={28}/><span>YOUR COLLECTION</span></div></div><div className="floating-service spotify"><Music2 size={30}/></div><div className="floating-service youtube"><Play size={25} fill="currentColor"/></div><span className="art-caption">THE NEXT TRACK STARTS HERE</span></div></section>
        <div className="stats-grid">{stats.map(stat => <section className="stat-card" key={stat.title}><div className="stat-top"><span>{stat.title}</span>{stat.icon}</div><strong>{number(stat.value)}</strong><p>{stat.detail}</p></section>)}</div>
        <section className="journey-panel"><div className="section-heading"><div><h2>Your move, step by step</h2><p>A little setup. A lot of music.</p></div><span className="tag">ONE-WAY TRANSFER</span></div><div className="steps">{stages.map((stage, index) => <div className={`step ${stage.complete ? 'complete' : ''}`} key={stage.name}><span className="step-number">{stage.complete ? <Check size={15}/> : String(index + 1).padStart(2, '0')}</span><strong>{stage.name}</strong>{index < stages.length - 1 && <span className="step-line"/>}</div>)}</div></section>
        <div className="overview-bottom"><section className={`import-card ${dragging ? 'dragging' : ''}`} onDragOver={e => { e.preventDefault(); setDragging(true); }} onDragLeave={() => setDragging(false)} onDrop={e => { e.preventDefault(); setDragging(false); if (!busy) void onDrop(e.dataTransfer.files); }}><span className="import-symbol">{busy ? <Spinner/> : <FileJson size={27}/>}</span><h3>{busy ? 'Making room for your musicâ€¦' : 'Your Spotify export goes here'}</h3><p>Drop an Account data ZIP or JSON file.<br/>Add Extended streaming history whenever you're ready.</p><button className="btn secondary" onClick={onImport} disabled={busy}>Browse files <Plus size={16}/></button><span className="fine-print">ZIP / JSON Â· Up to 512 MB per upload</span></section><section className="connection-panel"><div className="section-heading"><h2>Connected accounts</h2><button className="text-button" onClick={() => navigate('settings')}>Manage <ArrowUpRight size={14}/></button></div><div className="account-row"><span className="service-icon spotify"><Music2 size={22}/></span><div><strong>Spotify</strong><span>{connections.spotify.account || (hasData ? 'Data archive imported' : 'Connect your Free or Premium account')}</span></div><Badge status={connections.spotify.connected || hasData ? 'connected' : 'not_connected'}/></div><div className="account-row"><span className="service-icon youtube"><Play size={19} fill="currentColor"/></span><div><strong>YouTube Music</strong><span>{connections.youtube.account || 'Connect your destination account'}</span></div><Badge status={connections.youtube.connected ? 'connected' : 'not_connected'}/></div><div className="connection-note"><ShieldCheck size={18}/><p>Account credentials are encrypted on your server. You control every transfer.</p></div>{collections.length > 0 && <div className="recent-import"><span>LATEST IN YOUR COLLECTION</span><strong><ListMusic size={16}/>{collections.at(-1)?.name}</strong></div>}</section></div>
        {overview.imports.some(i => i.stats.warnings.length) && <details className="import-warnings"><summary><CircleAlert size={16}/> Import notes and unsupported records</summary>{overview.imports.slice(0, 5).flatMap(i => i.stats.warnings.map((warning, index) => <p key={`${i.id}-${index}`}>{warning}</p>))}</details>}
      </>;
    }
    
    function useData<T>(path: string, version = 0) {
      const [data, setData] = useState<T>(); const [error, setError] = useState('');
      useEffect(() => { const controller = new AbortController(); setError(''); api<T>(path, { signal: controller.signal }).then(setData).catch(e => { if (!controller.signal.aborted) setError(errorMessage(e)); }); return () => controller.abort(); }, [path, version]);
      return { data, error };
    }
    function LibraryScreen({ collections, selected, setSelected, flags, setFlags, overview, refreshVersion, run, onImport }: { collections: Collection[]; selected: Set<string>; setSelected: (value: Set<string>) => void; flags: { likes: boolean; songs: boolean; albums: boolean; artists: boolean }; setFlags: (value: typeof flags) => void; overview: Overview; refreshVersion: number; run: (fn: () => Promise<unknown>, message?: string) => Promise<void>; onImport: () => void }) {
      const [tab, setTab] = useState('playlists'); const [search, setSearch] = useState(''); const [page, setPage] = useState(1); const [preview, setPreview] = useState<Collection>();
      const kind = tab === 'albums' ? 'album' : tab === 'artists' ? 'artist' : 'song';
      const { data, error } = useData<Page<EntityView>>(`/api/library/entities?kind=${kind}&${tab === 'likes' ? 'liked=true' : tab === 'artists' ? 'followed=true' : 'saved=true'}&q=${encodeURIComponent(search)}&page=${page}`, refreshVersion);
      const filtered = collections.filter(c => c.name.toLowerCase().includes(search.toLowerCase()));
      const toggle = (id: string) => { const next = new Set(selected); if (next.has(id)) next.delete(id); else next.add(id); setSelected(next); };
      return <><div className="page-heading"><div><span className="eyebrow">THE COLLECTION YOU'VE BUILT</span><h1>All your favorites, together.</h1><p>Choose what comes with you. Your original Spotify collection stays intact.</p></div><button className="btn secondary" onClick={onImport}><Plus size={17}/> Import music</button></div><div className="library-options">{(['likes', 'songs', 'albums', 'artists'] as const).map(key => <label className="check-option" key={key}><input type="checkbox" checked={flags[key]} onChange={e => setFlags({ ...flags, [key]: e.target.checked })}/>{({ likes: 'Transfer native likes', songs: 'Save songs to library', albums: 'Save albums', artists: 'Follow artists' })[key]}</label>)}</div><div className="toolbar"><div className="tabs">{[['playlists', 'Playlists', overview.counts.playlists], ['likes', 'Liked songs', overview.counts.likes], ['songs', 'Saved songs', null], ['albums', 'Albums', overview.counts.albums], ['artists', 'Artists', overview.counts.artists]].map(([id, label, count]) => <button key={id} className={tab === id ? 'active' : ''} onClick={() => { setTab(String(id)); setPage(1); setSearch(''); }}>{label}{count !== null && <span>{number(Number(count))}</span>}</button>)}</div><label className="search-field"><Search size={17}/><input aria-label="Search collection" placeholder="Search your collection" value={search} onChange={e => { setSearch(e.target.value); setPage(1); }}/></label></div>
        {tab === 'playlists' ? <><div className="list-heading"><label className="check-option"><input type="checkbox" checked={filtered.filter(c => !c.inaccessible).length > 0 && filtered.filter(c => !c.inaccessible).every(c => selected.has(c.id))} onChange={e => { const next = new Set(selected); filtered.filter(c => !c.inaccessible).forEach(c => e.target.checked ? next.add(c.id) : next.delete(c.id)); setSelected(next); }}/> Select all visible playlists</label><span>{number(selected.size)} selected</span></div>{filtered.length ? <div className="playlist-grid">{filtered.map(collection => <article className={`playlist-card ${selected.has(collection.id) ? 'checked' : ''}`} key={collection.id}><div className="playlist-art"><Cover id={collection.id} name={collection.name}/><label className="cover-checkbox"><input type="checkbox" aria-label={`Transfer ${collection.name}`} disabled={collection.inaccessible} checked={selected.has(collection.id)} onChange={() => toggle(collection.id)}/></label><button className="preview-button" aria-label={`Preview ${collection.name}`} onClick={() => setPreview(collection)}><ListMusic size={20}/></button></div><div className="playlist-info"><span className="eyebrow">{collection.generated ? 'FROM YOUR HISTORY' : 'SPOTIFY PLAYLIST'}</span><h3 title={collection.name}>{collection.name}</h3><p>{collection.inaccessible ? 'Archive needed for playlist contents' : `${number(collection.count)} tracks`}</p><button className="text-button" onClick={() => setPreview(collection)}>View tracks <ArrowUpRight size={14}/></button></div></article>)}</div> : <Empty icon={<Library size={30}/>} title={search ? 'No playlists match that search.' : 'Your playlists are waiting.'}>Import your Spotify Account data to see every playlist here.</Empty>}</> : error ? <div className="inline-error">{error}</div> : !data ? <div className="loading"><Spinner/> Loading recordsâ€¦</div> : data.items.length ? <section className="table-panel"><table><thead><tr><th>{tab === 'artists' ? 'Artist' : 'Name'}</th><th>Artist / album</th><th>Match</th><th>Destination</th></tr></thead><tbody>{data.items.map(entity => <tr key={entity.id}><td><div className="track-name"><Cover id={entity.id} name={entity.name} small/><strong>{entity.name}</strong></div></td><td>{entity.artists.join(', ')}{entity.album && <small>{entity.album}</small>}</td><td><Badge status={entity.matchStatus}/></td><td>{entity.target ? <a className="text-button" href={entity.target.url} target="_blank" rel="noreferrer">Open <ExternalLink size={13}/></a> : <span className="muted">â€”</span>}</td></tr>)}</tbody></table><Pager page={page} total={data.total} size={data.pageSize} change={setPage}/></section> : <Empty icon={<Music2 size={30}/>} title="Nothing in this part of your collection yet.">Include YourLibrary.json in your Spotify Account data import.</Empty>}
        {preview && <PlaylistPreview collection={preview} onClose={() => setPreview(undefined)}/>}
      </>;
    }
    function PlaylistPreview({ collection, onClose }: { collection: Collection; onClose: () => void }) {
      const [page, setPage] = useState(1); const { data, error } = useData<Page<EntityView & { position: number }>>(`/api/library/collections/${collection.id}?page=${page}`);
      return <Modal title={collection.name} onClose={onClose}><p className="muted">{collection.description || 'An imported Spotify playlist.'}</p><p className="fine-print">Original order and repeated songs are preserved.</p>{error && <p className="inline-error">{error}</p>}{!data ? <div className="loading"><Spinner/></div> : <><div className="preview-tracks">{data.items.map(entity => <div key={entity.position}><span>{entity.position + 1}</span><div><strong>{entity.name}</strong><small>{entity.artists.join(', ')}</small></div><Badge status={entity.matchStatus}/></div>)}</div><Pager page={page} total={data.total} size={data.pageSize} change={setPage}/></>}</Modal>;
      const [spotifySession, setSpotifySession] = useState('');
      const [cookie, setCookie] = useState(''); const [accountIndex, setAccountIndex] = useState(0); const [channelId, setChannelId] = useState(''); const [deleting, setDeleting] = useState(false); const [confirmation, setConfirmation] = useState('');
      return <><div className="page-heading"><div><span className="eyebrow">YOU'RE IN CONTROL</span><h1>Connect your next chapter.</h1><p>Choose your accounts and manage the data on your installation.</p></div><a className="btn secondary" href="/api/docs" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer">API reference <ExternalLink size={15}/></a></div><div className="settings-grid"><section className="settings-card"><div className="settings-card-heading"><span className="service-icon youtube"><Play fill="currentColor" size={21}/></span><div><h2>YouTube Music</h2><p>The destination for your collection.</p></div><Badge status={connections.youtube.connected ? 'connected' : 'not_connected'}/></div>{connections.youtube.connected && <div className="connected-account"><CheckCircle2 size={18}/><strong>{connections.youtube.account}</strong><button className="text-button danger-text" disabled={busy} onClick={() => void run(() => api('/api/connections/youtube', { method: 'DELETE' }), 'YouTube Music disconnected. Stored session credentials removed.')}>Disconnect</button></div>}<details className="setup-guide" open={!connections.youtube.connected}><summary>How to connect your account</summary><ol><li>Open <a href="https://music.youtube.com" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer">music.youtube.com</a> and select the account you want to receive your music.</li><li>Open your browser's developer tools, then the <strong>Network</strong> tab.</li><li>Click Library and select a request containing <code>/browse</code>.</li><li>Under Request Headers, copy the value of the <strong>Cookie</strong> header. It is encrypted on the server and never included in exports.</p></details><form onSubmit={e => { e.preventDefault(); void run(async () => { await api('/api/connections/youtube', { method: 'POST', body: { cookie, accountIndex, ...(channelId ? { channelId } : {}) } }); setCookie(''); }, 'YouTube Music connected and the active account verified.'); }}><label>YouTube session cookie<textarea rows={4} value={cookie} onChange={e => setCookie(e.target.value)} minLength={20} maxLength={32000} required autoComplete="off" spellCheck={false} placeholder="Paste the Cookie request-header value"/></label><details className="advanced"><summary>Multiple accounts or a brand channel</summary><div className="form-row"><label>Google account index<input type="number" min={0} max={20} value={accountIndex} onChange={e => setAccountIndex(Number(e.target.value))}/></label><label>Brand channel ID (optional)<input value={channelId} onChange={e => setChannelId(e.target.value)} placeholder="Channel or brand account ID"/></label></div><p className="fine-print">Use the x-goog-authuser request-header value as the account index when needed.</p></details><button className="btn primary" disabled={busy || !cookie}>{busy ? <Spinner/> : <ShieldCheck size={17}/>} {connections.youtube.connected ? 'Replace and verify session' : 'Connect & verify account'}</button></form></section>
          <section className="settings-card spotify-settings">
            <div className="settings-card-heading"><span className="service-icon spotify"><Music2 size={24}/></span><div><h2>Spotify</h2><p>Your playlists and favorites, on any plan.</p></div><Badge status={connections.spotify.connected ? 'connected' : 'not_connected'}/></div>
            {connections.spotify.connected && <div className="connected-account"><CheckCircle2 size={18}/><strong>{connections.spotify.account}</strong><button className="text-button danger-text" disabled={busy} onClick={() => void run(() => api('/api/connections/spotify', { method: 'DELETE' }), 'Spotify disconnected. Stored session removed.')}>Disconnect</button></div>}
            <div className="info-banner"><CheckCircle2 size={20}/><p>Spotify Free works. No developer app or API key is needed.</p></div>
            <details className="setup-guide" open={!connections.spotify.connected}><summary>How to connect Spotify</summary><ol>
              <li>Open <a href="https://open.spotify.com" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer">open.spotify.com</a> and sign in to the account you want to transfer.</li>
              <li>Press <strong>F12</strong> (or right-click â†’ Inspect). Open <strong>Application â†’ Cookies â†’ https://open.spotify.com</strong> in Chrome or Edge. In Firefox use <strong>Storage â†’ Cookies</strong>.</li>
              <li>Find <code>sp_dc</code>, double-click its <strong>Value</strong>, and copy it. Paste that value below.</li>

            <form onSubmit={e => { e.preventDefault(); void run(async () => {
              await api('/api/connections/spotify', { method: 'POST', body: { cookie: spotifySession } }); setSpotifySession('');

            }, 'Spotify connected. Your playlists and liked songs are being imported.'); }}>
              <label>Spotify session cookie<textarea rows={3} value={spotifySession} onChange={e => setSpotifySession(e.target.value)} minLength={20} maxLength={32000} required autoComplete="off" spellCheck={false} placeholder="Paste your sp_dc cookie value"/></label>
              <button className="btn primary" disabled={busy || !spotifySession.trim()}>{busy ? <Spinner/> : <Download size={17}/>} {connections.spotify.connected ? 'Reconnect & import library' : 'Connect & import library'}</button>
            </form>
            {connections.spotify.connected && <button className="btn secondary sync-library" disabled={busy} onClick={() => void run(async () => { await api('/api/imports/spotify', { method: 'POST' }); navigate('transfers'); }, 'Spotify import queued.')}><RefreshCw size={17}/> Refresh Spotify library</button>}
            <details className="setup-guide"><summary>Import an archive instead</summary><p>Upload Spotify Account data for playlists and saved music. Both exports are available to free accounts.</p><a className="text-button" href="https://www.spotify.com/account/privacy/" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer">Request your Spotify data <ArrowUpRight size={15}/></a><button className="btn secondary sync-library" onClick={onImport}><Upload size={17}/> Upload ZIP or JSON</button></details>
            {connections.spotify.configured && <details className="advanced"><summary>Developer app connection</summary><p className="fine-print">Use your configured Spotify developer app as an alternative. Spotify applies its developer-mode eligibility and playlist restrictions to this connection.</p><button className="btn secondary" disabled={busy} onClick={() => void run(async () => { const response = await api('/api/connections/spotify/authorize', { method: 'POST' }); location.assign(response.url); })}>Authorize developer app <ArrowRight size={16}/></button></details>}
          </section></div>
        <section className="data-settings"><div><span className="settings-symbol"><ShieldCheck size={25}/></span><h2>Your data stays yours.</h2><p>Export your music records and listening history whenever you like. A full installation backup also needs the SQLite database, retained source files, and encryption key.</p></div><div className="export-buttons"><a className="btn secondary" href="/api/export?type=library&format=json"><Download size={16}/> Library JSON</a><a className="btn secondary" href="/api/export?type=library&format=csv"><Download size={16}/> Library CSV</a><a className="btn secondary" href="/api/export?type=history&format=json"><Download size={16}/> History JSON</a><a className="btn secondary" href="/api/export?type=history&format=csv"><Download size={16}/> History CSV</a></div><div className="delete-data"><div><strong>Delete imported data</strong><p>Removes this installation's music records, source files, jobs, and transfer mappings.</p></div><button className="btn danger" disabled={busy} onClick={() => setDeleting(true)}>Delete imported data</button></div></section>{deleting && <Modal title="Delete imported data" onClose={() => setDeleting(false)}><p>This removes local imports, listening history, reports, and migration mappings. Music already transferred to YouTube Music stays there. Reimporting after this deletion can create new destination playlists.</p><label>Type DELETE MY IMPORTED DATA<input value={confirmation} onChange={e => setConfirmation(e.target.value)} autoComplete="off"/></label><div className="modal-footer"><button className="btn secondary" onClick={() => setDeleting(false)}>Keep my data</button><button className="btn danger" disabled={confirmation !== 'DELETE MY IMPORTED DATA' || busy} onClick={() => void run(async () => { await api('/api/data', { method: 'DELETE', body: { confirmation } }); setDeleting(false); }, 'Imported data deleted from this installation.')}>Delete permanently</button></div></Modal>}
      </>;
    }

    import { useEffect, useRef, type ReactNode } from 'react';
    import { LoaderCircle, Music2, X } from 'lucide-react';
    
    export function Spinner() { return <LoaderCircle size={17} className="spin"/>; }
    export function Badge({ status }: { status: string }) {
      return <span className={`badge ${status}`}>{status.replaceAll('_', ' ')}</span>;
    }
    export function Cover({ id, name, small = false }: { id: string; name: string; small?: boolean }) {
      const theme = parseInt(id.slice(0, 2), 16) % 6 || 0;
      return <div className={`cover theme-${theme} ${small ? 'cover-small' : ''}`} aria-hidden="true"><div className="cover-orbit"/><span>{name.slice(0, 1).toUpperCase()}</span><Music2 size={small ? 15 : 25}/></div>;
    }
    export function Modal({ title, children, onClose }: { title: string; children: ReactNode; onClose: () => void }) {
      const ref = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
      const close = useRef(onClose); close.current = onClose;
      useEffect(() => {
        const previous = document.activeElement as HTMLElement | null;
        const overflow = document.body.style.overflow;
        document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
        ref.current?.focus();
        const key = (event: KeyboardEvent) => {
          if (event.key === 'Escape') close.current();
          if (event.key !== 'Tab') return;
          const items = [...(ref.current?.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>('button:not(:disabled),input:not(:disabled),textarea:not(:disabled),select,summary,a[href]') || [])].filter(item => item.getClientRects().length);
          if (!items.length) { event.preventDefault(); return; }
          if (event.shiftKey && (document.activeElement === items[0] || document.activeElement === ref.current)) { event.preventDefault(); items.at(-1)?.focus(); }
          else if (!event.shiftKey && document.activeElement === items.at(-1)) { event.preventDefault(); items[0].focus(); }
        };
        document.addEventListener('keydown', key);
        return () => { document.removeEventListener('keydown', key); document.body.style.overflow = overflow; previous?.focus(); };
      }, []);
      return <div className="modal-backdrop" onMouseDown={event => { if (event.target === event.currentTarget) onClose(); }}>
        <div className="modal" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-label={title} tabIndex={-1} ref={ref}>
          <div className="modal-heading"><h2>{title}</h2><button className="icon-button" aria-label="Close dialog" onClick={onClose}><X size={20}/></button></div>
          {children}
        </div>
      </div>;
    }

    import { readFileSync, writeFileSync } from 'node:fs';
    import ts from 'typescript';
    const path = 'src/App.tsx';
    let source = readFileSync(path, 'utf8');
    const file = ts.createSourceFile(path, source, ts.ScriptTarget.Latest, true, ts.ScriptKind.TSX);
    const counts = new Map();
    function visit(node) { if (ts.isIdentifier(node)) counts.set(node.text, (counts.get(node.text) || 0) + 1); ts.forEachChild(node, visit); }
    visit(file);
    const edits = [];
    for (const node of file.statements) {
      if (!ts.isImportDeclaration(node) || !node.importClause?.namedBindings || !ts.isNamedImports(node.importClause.namedBindings)) continue;
      const specifiers = node.importClause.namedBindings.elements;
      const retained = specifiers.filter(specifier => counts.get(specifier.name.text) > 1);
      if (retained.length === specifiers.length) continue;
      const clause = retained.length ? `import ${node.importClause.isTypeOnly ? 'type ' : ''}{ ${retained.map(item => item.getText(file)).join(', ')} } from ${node.moduleSpecifier.getText(file)};` : '';
      edits.push({ start: node.getStart(file), end: node.end, clause });
    }
    for (const edit of edits.reverse()) source = source.slice(0, edit.start) + edit.clause + source.slice(edit.end);
    writeFileSync(path, source);

    export const normalize = (value: string) => value.normalize('NFKC').toLocaleLowerCase('en').replace(/[â€™â€˜]/g, "'").replace(/[^\p{L}\p{N}]+/gu, ' ').trim();
    const versions = (name: string) => (normalize(name).match(/\b(live|remix|cover|instrumental|acoustic|karaoke|sped up|slowed|clean|remaster(?:ed)?)\b/g) || []).sort().join('|');
    const similarity = (a: string, b: string) => {
      const first = new Set(normalize(a).split(' ')); const second = new Set(normalize(b).split(' '));
      return [...first].filter(x => second.has(x)).length / Math.max(first.size, second.size, 1);
    };
    export function chooseMatch(source: SourceEntity, candidates: Candidate[]): { status: MatchStatus; target?: Candidate; candidates: Candidate[]; reason: string } {
      if (source.local) return { status: 'skipped', candidates: [], reason: 'Local audio files cannot be transferred as catalog references.' };
      const scored = candidates.filter(c => c.available !== false).map(candidate => {
        const title = similarity(source.name, candidate.name);
        const artist = source.kind === 'artist' ? title : Math.max(0, ...source.artists.flatMap(a => candidate.artists.map(b => similarity(a, b))));
        const album = source.album && candidate.album ? similarity(source.album, candidate.album) : 0;
        return { ...candidate, score: Math.round((title * 0.55 + artist * 0.35 + album * 0.1) * 100) };
      }).sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score);
      const exact = scored.filter(c => normalize(source.name) === normalize(c.name) && versions(source.name) === versions(c.name)
        && (source.kind === 'artist' || source.artists.some(a => c.artists.some(b => normalize(a) === normalize(b))))
        && (source.explicit === undefined || c.explicit === undefined || source.explicit === c.explicit)
        && (source.durationMs === undefined || c.durationMs === undefined || Math.abs(source.durationMs - c.durationMs) <= Math.max(5000, source.durationMs * 0.03)));
      const albumExact = source.album ? exact.filter(c => c.album && normalize(c.album) === normalize(source.album!)) : [];
      const strong = albumExact.length ? albumExact : exact;
      if (strong.length === 1) return { status: 'matched', target: strong[0], candidates: scored, reason: 'Unambiguous title, artist, and version match.' };
      return { status: scored.length ? 'review' : 'missing', candidates: scored, reason: scored.length ? 'Choose the correct recording or skip this item.' : 'No available catalog match found.' };
    }

      if (unresolved.length) throw new Error(`Review or explicitly skip ${unresolved.length} unresolved matches before transferring.`);
      const steps: { kind: string; sourceId: string }[] = []; const sequences: Record<string, string[]> = {};

        if (!collection) throw new Error('A selected playlist no longer exists.');
        if (collection.inaccessible) throw new Error(`Upload archive contents for "${collection.name}" or deselect it.`);
        steps.push({ kind: 'playlist', sourceId: JSON.stringify(collection) });
        const entries = store.all('SELECT entity_id,position FROM entries WHERE collection_id=? ORDER BY position', collectionId);
        sequences[collectionId] = []; let destinationIndex = 0;

        }

      const favorites = new Set(selection.favoriteIds);
      for (const entity of entities as EntityView[]) {
        if (entity.kind === 'song') {
          if ((selection.likes && entity.liked) || favorites.has(entity.id)) steps.push({ kind: 'like', sourceId: JSON.stringify(entity) });
          if (selection.songs && entity.saved) steps.push({ kind: 'song', sourceId: JSON.stringify(entity) });
        }
      }
      for (const kind of ['album', 'artist'] as const) for (const entity of entities as EntityView[]) {
        if (entity.kind === kind && (kind === 'album' ? selection.albums && entity.saved : selection.artists && entity.followed)) steps.push({ kind, sourceId: JSON.stringify(entity) });
      }

    test('only an unambiguous recording is selected automatically', () => {
      assert.equal(chooseMatch(source, [candidate]).status, 'matched');
      assert.equal(chooseMatch(source, [candidate, { ...candidate, id: 'two' }]).status, 'review');
      for (const name of ['Song (Live)', 'Song (Cover)', 'Song (Remix)', 'Song (Acoustic)', 'Song (Sped Up)']) assert.equal(chooseMatch(source, [{ ...candidate, name }]).status, 'review');
      assert.equal(chooseMatch(source, [{ ...candidate, artists: ['Other artist'] }]).status, 'review');
      assert.equal(chooseMatch(source, [{ ...candidate, durationMs: 230000 }]).status, 'review');
      assert.equal(chooseMatch(source, [{ ...candidate, available: false }]).status, 'missing');
      assert.equal(chooseMatch({ ...source, local: true }, [candidate]).status, 'skipped');
    });
    test('albums and artists follow the same ambiguity rule; missing duration does not invent one', () => {
      assert.equal(chooseMatch({ ...source, kind: 'album', name: 'Album', durationMs: undefined }, [{ ...candidate, name: 'Album' }]).status, 'matched');
      assert.equal(chooseMatch({ ...source, kind: 'artist', name: 'Artist', durationMs: undefined }, [{ ...candidate, name: 'Artist' }]).status, 'matched');
      assert.equal(chooseMatch({ ...source, durationMs: undefined }, [{ ...candidate, durationMs: undefined }]).status, 'matched');
      assert.equal(chooseMatch({ ...source, explicit: true }, [{ ...candidate, explicit: false }]).status, 'review');
    });

    import { Store } from '../server/store.js';
    import { Worker, createTransfer, reconcilePlaylist } from '../server/worker.js';
    import { ProviderError, ReviewRequired } from '../server/youtube.js';
    import { FakeMusic, temporaryDirectory } from './helpers.js';
    
    const selection = { collectionIds: [] as string[], likes: true, songs: true, albums: true, artists: true, favoriteIds: [] as string[] };
    function resolved(store: Store, kind: 'song' | 'album' | 'artist', name: string, target: string) {
      const id = store.entity({ kind, name, artists: ['Artist'], liked: kind === 'song', saved: kind !== 'artist', followed: kind === 'artist' });
      store.run("UPDATE entities SET status='matched',target=? WHERE id=?", JSON.stringify({ id: target, name, artists: ['Artist'], url: `https://music.youtube.com/browse/${target}` }), id); return id;
    }
    test('batch playlist transfer preserves repeated songs and performs native likes, saves, and subscriptions', async () => {
      const temp = await temporaryDirectory(); const store = new Store(join(temp.directory, 'data')); const provider = new FakeMusic(); const worker = new Worker(store, async () => provider);
      try {
        const a = resolved(store, 'song', 'First', 'a'); const b = resolved(store, 'song', 'Second', 'b'); resolved(store, 'album', 'Album', 'album'); resolved(store, 'artist', 'Artist', 'artist');
        const playlist = store.collection('test:playlist', { name: 'A playlist', description: 'Original description' }, [a, b, a]);
        const job = createTransfer(store, { ...selection, collectionIds: [playlist] }, provider.identity); await worker.tick();
        assert.equal(store.getJob(job.id)!.status, 'completed'); assert.deepEqual([...provider.playlists.values()][0].ids, ['a', 'b', 'a']);
        assert.equal(provider.calls.appends, 1); assert.equal(provider.likes.size, 2); assert.equal(provider.songs.size, 2); assert.equal(provider.albums.size, 1); assert.equal(provider.artists.size, 1);
        const repeat = createTransfer(store, { ...selection, collectionIds: [playlist] }, provider.identity); await worker.tick();
        assert.equal(store.getJob(repeat.id)!.status, 'completed'); assert.equal(provider.calls.creates, 1); assert.equal(provider.calls.appends, 1); assert.equal(provider.calls.likes, 2);
        assert.equal(store.all('SELECT * FROM steps WHERE job_id=?', job.id).length, job.total);
      } finally { await worker.stop(); store.close(); await temp.cleanup(); }
    });
    test('lost responses after successful creation and append are reconciled without duplicates', async () => {
      const temp = await temporaryDirectory(); const store = new Store(join(temp.directory, 'data')); const provider = new FakeMusic(); provider.failAfterCreate = true; provider.failAfterAppend = true;
      const worker = new Worker(store, async () => provider);
      try {
        const song = resolved(store, 'song', 'Song', 'a'); const playlist = store.collection('uncertain', { name: 'Uncertain write', description: '' }, [song, song]);
        const job = createTransfer(store, { ...selection, collectionIds: [playlist], likes: false, songs: false }, provider.identity); await worker.tick();
        assert.equal(store.getJob(job.id)!.status, 'completed'); assert.equal(provider.calls.creates, 1); assert.equal(provider.calls.appends, 1); assert.deepEqual([...provider.playlists.values()][0].ids, ['a', 'a']);
      } finally { await worker.stop(); store.close(); await temp.cleanup(); }
    });

      assert.throws(() => reconcilePlaylist(['b', 'a'], ['a', 'b'], ['a']), ReviewRequired);
      assert.throws(() => reconcilePlaylist([], ['a', 'b'], ['a']), ReviewRequired);
      const temp = await temporaryDirectory(); const store = new Store(join(temp.directory, 'data')); const provider = new FakeMusic(); const worker = new Worker(store, async () => provider);
      try {
        const id = store.entity({ kind: 'song', name: 'Song', artists: ['Artist'] }); provider.searchError = new ProviderError('Expired session.', 401);
        const job = store.job('match', {}, [{ kind: 'match', sourceId: id }]); await worker.tick(); assert.equal(store.getJob(job.id)!.status, 'paused');
        provider.searchError = undefined; store.updateJob(job.id, 'queued'); await worker.tick(); assert.equal(store.getJob(job.id)!.status, 'completed');
        const song = resolved(store, 'song', 'Song', 'a'); const transfer = createTransfer(store, { ...selection, likes: true, songs: false, albums: false, artists: false }, '@another-owner');
        await worker.tick(); assert.equal(store.getJob(transfer.id)!.status, 'needs_review'); assert.equal(provider.calls.likes, 0);
      } finally { await worker.stop(); store.close(); await temp.cleanup(); }
    });

      const temp = await temporaryDirectory(); const store = new Store(join(temp.directory, 'data')); const provider = new FakeMusic(); const worker = new Worker(store, async () => provider);

        assert.equal(store.getJob(job.id)!.status, 'paused'); store.updateJob(job.id, 'queued'); await worker.tick(); assert.equal(store.getJob(job.id)!.skipped, 1); assert.equal(provider.calls.likes, 0);
