    3. Copy the **Cookie** request-header value, and paste it into Connections & settings.
    4. If you use multiple Google accounts, enter the `x-goog-authuser` header value as the account index. Advanced brand-channel identification is available when required.
    5. Connect and confirm the account name shown before starting a transfer. Sessions can expire; reconnect with a fresh cookie when a job asks you to.
    
    Cookies are credentials. Encore encrypts them using AES-256-GCM and never returns them from connection-status endpoints, music exports, or reports. The encryption key is generated in the persistent data volume unless `ENCRYPTION_KEY` is provided as a base64-encoded 32-byte value. Keep this key with database backups. YouTube may change internal endpoints; the provider adapter is contained in `server/youtube.ts` so it can be updated independently.
    
    ## Optional Spotify developer-app connection
    
    The default browser-session connection above does **not** need this configuration. As an alternative, set `SPOTIFY_CLIENT_ID` and register `SPOTIFY_REDIRECT_URI` exactly in your Spotify developer app. The local default uses `127.0.0.1`, not `localhost`. Hosted callbacks need HTTPS. The **Developer app connection** option appears in Settings only when configured.
    
    Spotify's development mode requires a Premium app owner and approved users, and limits playlist-content access. Encore requests only read scopes and uses PKCE. Inaccessible playlists are marked as needing an archive. Full historical listening data still requires the extended-history export; the recent-play API supplies no listening duration and does not substitute for lifetime history. See [Spotify's current restrictions](https://developer.spotify.com/documentation/web-api/tutorials/february-2026-migration-guide).
    
    ## Match and transfer
    
    - Playlists are selected by default. Choose whether to transfer likes, saved songs, albums, and followed artists.
    - Run **Find matches**. Exact, unambiguous title/artist/version matches are selected automatically. Album, explicit status, and duration help when available. Listening time is never treated as recording duration.
    - Review uncertain and missing items. Search for another candidate, select it, or explicitly skip the source. Transfers require every selected source to be resolved. Local audio files are reported as skipped; catalog references are transferred, not audio files.
    - Start the transfer. Playlists go first, followed by likes/saved songs, albums, and artists. New playlists are private and include a small Encore migration marker in their description.
    - Jobs persist through page closure. After a server restart, interrupted jobs pause until resumed. Playlist writes are reconciled against ordered destination contents before retries, including duplicate occurrences. Externally changed playlist contents pause the job for review. Restore the prior contents/order before resuming; Encore does not overwrite external edits.
    - Failed operations can be retried from Transfers. Cancelling stops future operations; completed destination writes remain. Reports include each playlist entry and library operation, including skipped and failed items.
    - Listening history remains browsable with date filters. Most-played playlists and additional favorite likes use qualified listening time, excluding explicit skips and plays shorter than 30 seconds. Additional likes require selection. YouTube controls recommendation behavior.
    
    ## Exports and API
    
    Connections & settings provides library/history JSON and CSV exports. Library JSON includes ordered playlist entries and match decisions. History JSON includes dated events and listening time. CSV cells are escaped to avoid spreadsheet formula execution. Original retained JSON files remain available in the persistent volume.
    
    The API reference is at **`/api/docs`**; OpenAPI JSON is at `/api/docs/json`. First call `GET /api/auth/status`, retain the HTTP-only `encore_session` cookie, and use the returned `csrf` value in the `x-csrf-token` header for writes. This automatically opens a local workspace session without a password. Endpoints cover imports, connections, library/history pagination, match review, transfers, job controls, and reports. `POST /api/connections/spotify` accepts `{ "cookie": "your_sp_dc_value" }`; `POST /api/imports/spotify` queues the live library import.
    
    ## Backup, restore, and upgrades
    
    Stop the application before copying the entire `data` directory or Docker volume. Include `encore.sqlite`, any `encore.sqlite-wal` / `encore.sqlite-shm` files still present, `encryption.key` (or the external key), and `imports/`. Starting the same version with that complete volume restores the owner, sessions, sources, credentials, mappings, and jobs. Library exports alone are portable music records, not a full installation backup.
    
    For Docker, `docker compose stop`, back up the named volume using your host's volume-backup tooling, then `docker compose start`. To upgrade, back up first and run `docker compose up -d --build`. The initial schema is version 1 (`PRAGMA user_version`); future incompatible schema changes must include an explicit migration. Avoid `docker compose down -v` unless you intend to delete all local data.
    
    Deleting imported data in Settings removes source records, retained files, jobs, and destination mappings, but retains connected accounts. Previously transferred music remains in YouTube Music. Reimporting after deleting mappings may create new destination playlists.

    export class Store {
      readonly db: DatabaseSync;
      constructor(readonly directory: string) {
        mkdirSync(directory, { recursive: true });
        this.db = new DatabaseSync(join(directory, 'encore.sqlite'));
        this.db.exec(`PRAGMA journal_mode=WAL; PRAGMA foreign_keys=ON; PRAGMA busy_timeout=5000;
          CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS settings (key TEXT PRIMARY KEY, value TEXT NOT NULL);
          CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sessions (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, csrf TEXT NOT NULL, expires INTEGER NOT NULL);
          CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS imports (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, sha TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL, name TEXT NOT NULL, created TEXT NOT NULL, stats TEXT NOT NULL);
          CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS entities (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, kind TEXT NOT NULL, name TEXT NOT NULL, body TEXT NOT NULL, status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', target TEXT, candidates TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', reason TEXT);
          CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS entity_kind ON entities(kind);
          CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS entity_status ON entities(status);
          CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS collections (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, source_key TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL, body TEXT NOT NULL);
          CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS entries (collection_id TEXT REFERENCES collections(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, position INTEGER NOT NULL, entity_id TEXT REFERENCES entities(id), PRIMARY KEY(collection_id,position));
          CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS history (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, entity_id TEXT REFERENCES entities(id), played_at TEXT NOT NULL, ms_played INTEGER NOT NULL, skipped INTEGER NOT NULL, source TEXT NOT NULL);
          CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS history_time ON history(played_at);
          CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS history_entity ON history(entity_id);
          CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS jobs (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, kind TEXT NOT NULL, status TEXT NOT NULL, payload TEXT NOT NULL, total INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, done INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, failed INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, skipped INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, message TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', created TEXT NOT NULL, updated TEXT NOT NULL);
          CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS steps (job_id TEXT REFERENCES jobs(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, seq INTEGER NOT NULL, kind TEXT NOT NULL, source_id TEXT NOT NULL, status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', reason TEXT, url TEXT, PRIMARY KEY(job_id,seq));
          CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS destinations (account TEXT NOT NULL, kind TEXT NOT NULL, source_id TEXT NOT NULL, target TEXT NOT NULL, expected TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', PRIMARY KEY(account,kind,source_id));
          PRAGMA user_version=1;`);
      }
      run(sql: string, ...params: any[]) { return this.db.prepare(sql).run(...params); }
      get(sql: string, ...params: any[]): Row | undefined { return this.db.prepare(sql).get(...params) as Row | undefined; }
      all(sql: string, ...params: any[]): Row[] { return this.db.prepare(sql).all(...params) as Row[]; }
      transaction<T>(fn: () => T): T {
        this.db.exec('BEGIN IMMEDIATE');
        try { const result = fn(); this.db.exec('COMMIT'); return result; }
        catch (error) { this.db.exec('ROLLBACK'); throw error; }
      }
      setting(key: string): string | undefined { return this.get('SELECT value FROM settings WHERE key=?', key)?.value; }
      setSetting(key: string, value: string) { this.run('INSERT INTO settings VALUES (?,?) ON CONFLICT(key) DO UPDATE SET value=excluded.value', key, value); }
      entity(source: Omit<SourceEntity, 'id'> & { id?: string }): string {
        const id = source.id || hash(source.uri || JSON.stringify([source.kind, source.name, source.artists, source.album || '', source.local || false]));
        const existing = this.get('SELECT body FROM entities WHERE id=?', id);
        const old: Partial<SourceEntity> = existing ? JSON.parse(existing.body) : {};
        const body = { ...old, ...Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(source).filter(([, value]) => value !== undefined)), id,
          liked: !!(old.liked || source.liked), saved: !!(old.saved || source.saved), followed: !!(old.followed || source.followed) };
        this.run('INSERT INTO entities(id,kind,name,body) VALUES (?,?,?,?) ON CONFLICT(id) DO UPDATE SET body=excluded.body,name=excluded.name', id, source.kind, body.name, JSON.stringify(body));
        return id;
      }
      entityView(row: Row): EntityView {
        return { ...JSON.parse(row.body), matchStatus: row.status, target: row.target ? JSON.parse(row.target) : undefined, candidates: JSON.parse(row.candidates), reason: row.reason || undefined };
      }
      getEntity(id: string): EntityView | undefined { const row = this.get('SELECT * FROM entities WHERE id=?', id); return row ? this.entityView(row) : undefined; }
      collection(sourceKey: string, body: Omit<Collection, 'id' | 'count'>, entityIds: string[]): string {
        const existing = this.get('SELECT id FROM collections WHERE source_key=?', sourceKey);
        const id = existing?.id || hash(sourceKey);
        this.transaction(() => {
          this.run('INSERT INTO collections VALUES (?,?,?) ON CONFLICT(id) DO UPDATE SET body=excluded.body', id, sourceKey, JSON.stringify({ ...body, id, count: entityIds.length }));
          this.run('DELETE FROM entries WHERE collection_id=?', id);
          const stmt = this.db.prepare('INSERT INTO entries VALUES (?,?,?)');
          entityIds.forEach((entityId, position) => stmt.run(id, position, entityId));
        });
        return id;
      }
      collections(): Collection[] { return this.all('SELECT body FROM collections ORDER BY rowid').map(row => JSON.parse(row.body)); }
      job(kind: Job['kind'], payload: unknown, steps: { kind: string; sourceId: string }[] = []): Job {
        const id = randomUUID(); const timestamp = now();
        this.transaction(() => {
          this.run('INSERT INTO jobs(id,kind,status,payload,total,created,updated) VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?)', id, kind, 'queued', JSON.stringify(payload), steps.length, timestamp, timestamp);
          steps.forEach((step, seq) => this.run('INSERT INTO steps(job_id,seq,kind,source_id) VALUES (?,?,?,?)', id, seq, step.kind, step.sourceId));
        });
        return this.getJob(id)!;
      }
      jobView(row: Row): Job { return { id: row.id, kind: row.kind, status: row.status, total: row.total, done: row.done, failed: row.failed, skipped: row.skipped, message: row.message, createdAt: row.created, updatedAt: row.updated }; }
      getJob(id: string): Job | undefined { const row = this.get('SELECT * FROM jobs WHERE id=?', id); return row ? this.jobView(row) : undefined; }
      updateJob(id: string, status: JobStatus, message?: string) {
        this.run('UPDATE jobs SET status=?,message=COALESCE(?,message),updated=? WHERE id=?', status, message ?? null, now(), id);
      }
      stepResult(jobId: string, seq: number, status: string, reason?: string, url?: string) {
        this.transaction(() => {
          this.run('UPDATE steps SET status=?,reason=?,url=? WHERE job_id=? AND seq=?', status, reason || null, url || null, jobId, seq);
          const counts = this.get("SELECT SUM(status='done') AS done,SUM(status='failed') AS failed,SUM(status='skipped') AS skipped FROM steps WHERE job_id=?", jobId)!;
          this.run('UPDATE jobs SET done=?,failed=?,skipped=?,updated=? WHERE id=?', counts.done || 0, counts.failed || 0, counts.skipped || 0, now(), jobId);
        });
      }
      close() { this.db.close(); }
    }

    import type { Collection, EntityView, TransferSelection } from '../shared/types.js';
    import { Store, hash } from './store.js';

    class Stopped extends Error {}
    export function selectedEntities(store: Store, selection: TransferSelection): string[] {
      const ids = new Set<string>(selection.favoriteIds);
      for (const id of selection.collectionIds) for (const row of store.all('SELECT entity_id FROM entries WHERE collection_id=? ORDER BY position', id)) ids.add(row.entity_id);
      const library = store.all(`SELECT id FROM entities WHERE
        (kind='song' AND ((?=1 AND json_extract(body,'$.liked')=1) OR (?=1 AND json_extract(body,'$.saved')=1)))
        OR (kind='album' AND ?=1 AND json_extract(body,'$.saved')=1)
        OR (kind='artist' AND ?=1 AND json_extract(body,'$.followed')=1)`, Number(selection.likes), Number(selection.songs), Number(selection.albums), Number(selection.artists));
      for (const row of library) ids.add(row.id);
      return [...ids];
    }
    interface TransferSnapshot { entityIds: string[]; collections: { collection: Collection; entries: string[] }[] }
    function snapshotSelection(store: Store, selection: TransferSelection): TransferSnapshot {
      const entityIds = selectedEntities(store, selection);
      if (entityIds.some(id => !store.getEntity(id))) throw new Error('A selected source record no longer exists.');
      const collections = selection.collectionIds.map(id => {
        const collection = store.collections().find(item => item.id === id);
        if (!collection) throw new Error('A selected playlist no longer exists.');
        if (collection.inaccessible) throw new Error(`Upload archive contents for "${collection.name}" or deselect it.`);
        return { collection, entries: store.all('SELECT entity_id FROM entries WHERE collection_id=? ORDER BY position', id).map(row => row.entity_id as string) };
      });
      if (!entityIds.length && !collections.length) throw new Error('Select at least one playlist or library item.');
      return { entityIds, collections };
    }
    
    export function queueTransfer(store: Store, selection: TransferSelection, account: string) {
      const snapshot = snapshotSelection(store, selection);
      const pending: string[] = [];
      // Existing review candidates can be resolved immediately without another catalog request.
      store.transaction(() => {
        for (const id of snapshot.entityIds) {
          const entity = store.getEntity(id)!;
          if (['matched', 'skipped'].includes(entity.matchStatus)) continue;
          if (!entity.local && !entity.candidates.length && entity.matchStatus !== 'missing') { pending.push(id); continue; }
          const result = chooseMatch(entity, entity.candidates);
          store.run('UPDATE entities SET status=?,target=?,candidates=?,reason=? WHERE id=?', result.status, result.target ? JSON.stringify(result.target) : null, JSON.stringify(result.candidates), result.reason, id);
        }
      });
      if (!pending.length) return createTransfer(store, selection, account, { snapshot });
      const job = store.job('match', { account, transferSelection: selection, transferSnapshot: snapshot }, pending.map(sourceId => ({ kind: 'match', sourceId })));
      store.updateJob(job.id, 'queued', 'Finding the best matches. Your transfer will start automatically.');
      return store.getJob(job.id)!;
    }
    
    export function createTransfer(store: Store, selection: TransferSelection, account: string, options: { snapshot?: TransferSnapshot; sourceMatchJobId?: string } = {}) {
      const snapshot = options.snapshot || snapshotSelection(store, selection);
      const entities = snapshot.entityIds.map(id => store.getEntity(id));
      if (entities.some(e => !e)) throw new Error('A selected source record no longer exists.');
      const unresolved = entities.filter(e => e && !['matched', 'skipped'].includes(e.matchStatus));
      if (unresolved.length) throw new Error(`Matching has not finished for ${unresolved.length} items. Retry the failed searches before continuing.`);
      const steps: { kind: string; sourceId: string }[] = []; const sequences: Record<string, string[]> = {};
      for (const { collection, entries } of snapshot.collections) {
        const collectionId = collection.id;
        steps.push({ kind: 'playlist', sourceId: JSON.stringify(collection) });
        sequences[collectionId] = []; let destinationIndex = 0;
        for (const [position, entityId] of entries.entries()) {
          const entity = store.getEntity(entityId)!;
          if (entity.matchStatus === 'matched') sequences[collectionId].push(entity.target!.id);
          steps.push({ kind: 'playlist_item', sourceId: JSON.stringify({ collectionId, position, destinationIndex: entity.matchStatus === 'matched' ? destinationIndex++ : -1, entity }) });
        }
      }
      const favorites = new Set(selection.favoriteIds);
      for (const entity of entities as EntityView[]) {
        if (entity.kind === 'song') {
          if ((selection.likes && entity.liked) || favorites.has(entity.id)) steps.push({ kind: 'like', sourceId: JSON.stringify(entity) });
          if (selection.songs && entity.saved) steps.push({ kind: 'song', sourceId: JSON.stringify(entity) });
        }
      }
      for (const kind of ['album', 'artist'] as const) for (const entity of entities as EntityView[]) {
        if (entity.kind === kind && (kind === 'album' ? selection.albums && entity.saved : selection.artists && entity.followed)) steps.push({ kind, sourceId: JSON.stringify(entity) });
      }
      if (!steps.length) throw new Error('Select at least one playlist or library item.');
      return store.job('transfer', { selection, account, sequences, ...(options.sourceMatchJobId ? { sourceMatchJobId: options.sourceMatchJobId } : {}) }, steps);
    }

      return actual.length;
    }

    import type { Collection, EntityView, TransferSelection } from '../shared/types.js';
    import { Store, hash } from './store.js';
    import { chooseMatch } from './matching.js';
    import { ProviderError, ReviewRequired, type MusicProvider } from './youtube.js';
    import type { SpotifyAdapter } from './spotify.js';
    
    class Stopped extends Error {}
    export function selectedEntities(store: Store, selection: TransferSelection): string[] {
      const ids = new Set<string>(selection.favoriteIds);
      for (const id of selection.collectionIds) for (const row of store.all('SELECT entity_id FROM entries WHERE collection_id=? ORDER BY position', id)) ids.add(row.entity_id);
      const library = store.all(`SELECT id FROM entities WHERE
        (kind='song' AND ((?=1 AND json_extract(body,'$.liked')=1) OR (?=1 AND json_extract(body,'$.saved')=1)))
        OR (kind='album' AND ?=1 AND json_extract(body,'$.saved')=1)
        OR (kind='artist' AND ?=1 AND json_extract(body,'$.followed')=1)`, Number(selection.likes), Number(selection.songs), Number(selection.albums), Number(selection.artists));
      for (const row of library) ids.add(row.id);
      return [...ids];
    }
    interface TransferSnapshot { entityIds: string[]; collections: { collection: Collection; entries: string[] }[] }
    function snapshotSelection(store: Store, selection: TransferSelection): TransferSnapshot {
      const entityIds = selectedEntities(store, selection);
      if (entityIds.some(id => !store.getEntity(id))) throw new Error('A selected source record no longer exists.');
      const collections = selection.collectionIds.map(id => {
        const collection = store.collections().find(item => item.id === id);
        if (!collection) throw new Error('A selected playlist no longer exists.');
        if (collection.inaccessible) throw new Error(`Upload archive contents for "${collection.name}" or deselect it.`);
        return { collection, entries: store.all('SELECT entity_id FROM entries WHERE collection_id=? ORDER BY position', id).map(row => row.entity_id as string) };
      });
      if (!entityIds.length && !collections.length) throw new Error('Select at least one playlist or library item.');
      return { entityIds, collections };
    }
    
    export function queueTransfer(store: Store, selection: TransferSelection, account: string) {
      const snapshot = snapshotSelection(store, selection);
      const pending: string[] = [];
      // Existing review candidates can be resolved immediately without another catalog request.
      store.transaction(() => {
        for (const id of snapshot.entityIds) {
          const entity = store.getEntity(id)!;
          if (['matched', 'skipped'].includes(entity.matchStatus)) continue;
          if (!entity.local && !entity.candidates.length && entity.matchStatus !== 'missing') { pending.push(id); continue; }
          const result = chooseMatch(entity, entity.candidates);
          store.run('UPDATE entities SET status=?,target=?,candidates=?,reason=? WHERE id=?', result.status, result.target ? JSON.stringify(result.target) : null, JSON.stringify(result.candidates), result.reason, id);
        }
      });
      if (!pending.length) return createTransfer(store, selection, account, { snapshot });
      const job = store.job('match', { account, transferSelection: selection, transferSnapshot: snapshot }, pending.map(sourceId => ({ kind: 'match', sourceId })));
      store.updateJob(job.id, 'queued', 'Finding the best matches. Your transfer will start automatically.');
      return store.getJob(job.id)!;
    }
    
    export function createTransfer(store: Store, selection: TransferSelection, account: string, options: { snapshot?: TransferSnapshot; sourceMatchJobId?: string } = {}) {
      const snapshot = options.snapshot || snapshotSelection(store, selection);
      const entities = snapshot.entityIds.map(id => store.getEntity(id));
      if (entities.some(e => !e)) throw new Error('A selected source record no longer exists.');
      const unresolved = entities.filter(e => e && !['matched', 'skipped'].includes(e.matchStatus));
      if (unresolved.length) throw new Error(`Matching has not finished for ${unresolved.length} items. Retry the failed searches before continuing.`);
      const steps: { kind: string; sourceId: string }[] = []; const sequences: Record<string, string[]> = {};
      for (const { collection, entries } of snapshot.collections) {
        const collectionId = collection.id;
        steps.push({ kind: 'playlist', sourceId: JSON.stringify(collection) });
        sequences[collectionId] = []; let destinationIndex = 0;
        for (const [position, entityId] of entries.entries()) {
          const entity = store.getEntity(entityId)!;
          if (entity.matchStatus === 'matched') sequences[collectionId].push(entity.target!.id);
          steps.push({ kind: 'playlist_item', sourceId: JSON.stringify({ collectionId, position, destinationIndex: entity.matchStatus === 'matched' ? destinationIndex++ : -1, entity }) });
        }
      }
      const favorites = new Set(selection.favoriteIds);
      for (const entity of entities as EntityView[]) {
        if (entity.kind === 'song') {
          if ((selection.likes && entity.liked) || favorites.has(entity.id)) steps.push({ kind: 'like', sourceId: JSON.stringify(entity) });
          if (selection.songs && entity.saved) steps.push({ kind: 'song', sourceId: JSON.stringify(entity) });
        }
      }
      for (const kind of ['album', 'artist'] as const) for (const entity of entities as EntityView[]) {
        if (entity.kind === kind && (kind === 'album' ? selection.albums && entity.saved : selection.artists && entity.followed)) steps.push({ kind, sourceId: JSON.stringify(entity) });
      }
      if (!steps.length) throw new Error('Select at least one playlist or library item.');
      return store.job('transfer', { selection, account, sequences, ...(options.sourceMatchJobId ? { sourceMatchJobId: options.sourceMatchJobId } : {}) }, steps);
    }
    const equal = (a: string[], b: string[]) => a.length === b.length && a.every((value, index) => b[index] === value);
    export function reconcilePlaylist(actual: string[], desired: string[], confirmed: string[]): number {
      if (actual.length < confirmed.length || !equal(actual.slice(0, confirmed.length), confirmed) || !equal(actual, desired.slice(0, actual.length))) throw new ReviewRequired('Destination playlist changed outside this transfer. Restore its previous order and contents in YouTube Music before resuming.');
      return actual.length;
    }
    
    export class Worker {
      private timer?: ReturnType<typeof setInterval>;
      private busy = false;
      private closed = false;
      constructor(private readonly store: Store, private readonly getProvider: () => Promise<MusicProvider>, private readonly spotify?: SpotifyAdapter) {}
      get isBusy() { return this.busy; }
      start() {
        this.store.run("UPDATE jobs SET status='paused',message='Interrupted by a server restart. Resume to reconcile and continue.' WHERE status='running'");
        this.timer = setInterval(() => { void this.tick(); }, 1000);
        this.timer.unref();
      }
      async stop() { this.closed = true; if (this.timer) clearInterval(this.timer); while (this.busy) await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 50)); }
      private check(id: string) { if (this.closed || this.store.getJob(id)?.status !== 'running') throw new Stopped(); }
      private async wait(id: string, ms: number) {
        const until = Date.now() + ms;
        while (Date.now() < until) { this.check(id); await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, Math.min(250, until - Date.now()))); }
      }
      private async retry<T>(id: string, action: () => Promise<T>): Promise<T> {
        for (let attempt = 0; ; attempt++) {
          this.check(id);
          try { return await action(); }
          catch (error) {
            if (error instanceof ReviewRequired || error instanceof Stopped || !(error instanceof ProviderError) || error.status < 429 || (error.status < 500 && error.status !== 429) || attempt >= 3) throw error;
            await this.wait(id, Math.min(300000, Math.max(error.retryAfter * 1000, 1000 * 2 ** attempt)));

    }

    # Full-Story Verification
    
    You are a verification orchestrator. Your job is not to run a single check â€” it is to **infer the complete user story** being built and verify every boundary in the flow with evidence.
    
    Your focus is the **end-to-end story**, not any single layer.
    
    ## When This Triggers
    
    - A dev server just started and the user wants to know if things work
    - The user says something "isn't quite right" or "almost works"
    - The user asks you to verify a feature or check the full flow
    
    ## Step 1 â€” Infer the User Story
    
    Before checking anything, determine **what is being built**:
    
    1. Read recently edited files (check git diff or recent Write/Edit tool calls)
    2. Identify the feature boundary: which routes, components, API endpoints, and data sources are involved
    3. Scan `package.json` scripts, route structure (`app/` or `pages/`), and environment files (`.env*`)
    4. State the story in one sentence: _"The user is building [X] which flows from [UI entry point] â†’ [API route] â†’ [data source] â†’ [response rendering]"_
    
    **Do not skip this step.** Every subsequent check must be anchored to the inferred story.
    
    ## Step 2 â€” Establish Evidence Baseline
    
    Gather the current state across all layers:
    
    | Layer | How to check | What to capture |
    |-------|-------------|-----------------|
    | **Browser** | Open the relevant page, check console, take screenshots | Visual state, console errors, network failures |
    | **Server terminal** | Read the terminal output from the dev server process | Startup errors, request logs, compilation warnings |
    | **Runtime logs** | Run `vercel logs` (if deployed) or check server stdout | API response codes, error traces, timing |
    | **Environment** | Check `.env.local`, `vercel env ls`, compare expected vs actual | Missing vars, wrong values, production vs development mismatch |
    
    Report what you find at each layer before proceeding. Use this reporting contract:
    
    > **Checking**: [what you're looking at]
    > **Evidence**: [what you found â€” quote actual output]
    > **Next**: [what this means for the next step]
    
    ## Step 3 â€” Walk the Data Flow
    
    Trace the feature's data path from trigger to completion:
    
    1. **UI trigger** â€” What user action initiates the flow? (button click, page load, form submit)
    2. **Client â†’ Server** â€” What request is made? Check the fetch/action call, verify the URL, method, and payload match the API route
    3. **API route handler** â€” Read the route file. Does it handle the method? Does it validate input? Does it call the right service/database?
    4. **External dependencies** â€” If the route calls a database, third-party API, or Vercel service (KV, Blob, Postgres, AI SDK): verify the client is initialized, credentials are present, and the call shape matches the SDK docs
    5. **Response â†’ UI** â€” Does the response format match what the client expects? Is error handling present on both sides?
    
    At each boundary, check for these common breaks:
    - **Missing `await`** on async operations
    - **Wrong HTTP method** (GET handler but POST fetch)
    - **Env var absent** in runtime but present in `.env.local`
    - **Import mismatch** (server module imported in client component or vice versa)
    - **Type mismatch** between API response and client expectation
    - **Missing error boundary** â€” unhandled rejection crashes the page silently
    
    ## Step 4 â€” Report With Evidence
    
    Summarize findings in a structured report:
    
    ```
    ## Verification Report: [Feature Name]
    
    **Story**: [one-sentence description of the user story]
    
    ### Flow Status
    | Boundary | Status | Evidence |
    |----------|--------|----------|
    | UI renders | âœ…/âŒ | [screenshot or console output] |
    | Client â†’ API | âœ…/âŒ | [request/response or error] |
    | API â†’ Data | âœ…/âŒ | [log output or error trace] |
    | Data â†’ Response | âœ…/âŒ | [response shape or error] |
    | Response â†’ UI | âœ…/âŒ | [rendered output or error] |
    
    ### Issues Found
    1. [Issue]: [evidence] â†’ [fix]
    
    ### Verified Working
    - [What was confirmed working with evidence]
    ```
    
    ## Stop Conditions
    
    **Stop verifying when**:
    - All boundaries in the flow are confirmed working with evidence â€” report success
    - You find the **first broken boundary** â€” report it with evidence and a specific fix, do not continue past the break
    - Two consecutive layers return no useful signal (e.g., no logs, no errors, no output) â€” flag the observability gap and recommend adding logging before continuing
    
    **Do not**:
    - Run the same check more than twice
    - Continue past a confirmed broken boundary
    - Verify unrelated features â€” stay on the inferred story

    test('YouTube adapter uses music-only candidates, explicit private creation, ordered duplicate writes, and native endpoints', async () => {
      const calls: { path: string; args: any }[] = []; let saved = false; let albumSaved = false; let subscribed = false;
      const endpoint = { call: async (_actions: unknown, args: any) => { assert.equal(args.client, 'YTMUSIC'); saved = true; return { success: true }; } };
      const albumEndpoint = { call: async (_actions: unknown, args: any) => { assert.equal(args.client, 'YTMUSIC'); albumSaved = true; return { success: true }; } };
      const client: any = {
        actions: { execute: async (path: string, args: any) => { calls.push({ path, args }); if (path === '/subscription/subscribe') subscribed = true; return { success: true, status_code: 200, data: { playlistId: 'PLtest' } }; } },
        music: {
          search: async () => ({ contents: [{ contents: [
            { item_type: 'video', id: 'video', title: 'Song', artists: [{ name: 'Artist' }] },
            { item_type: 'song', id: 'song', title: 'Song', artists: [{ name: 'Artist' }], duration: { seconds: 180 }, badges: [], menu: { items: [{ icon_type: saved ? 'LIBRARY_REMOVE' : 'LIBRARY_ADD', text: { toString: () => saved ? 'Remove from library' : 'Save to library' }, default_endpoint: endpoint }] } },
          ] }] }),
          getAlbum: async () => ({ header: { buttons: [{ type: 'ToggleButton', icon_type: 'LIBRARY_ADD', text: { toString: () => 'Save to library' }, is_toggled: albumSaved, endpoint: albumEndpoint }] } }),
          getArtist: async () => ({ header: { subscription_button: { type: 'SubscribeButton', channel_id: 'UCactual', subscribed } } }),
          getPlaylist: async () => ({ items: [{ id: 'song' }, { id: 'song' }], has_continuation: false }),
        },
      };
      const adapter = new YouTubeAdapter(client, '@owner', 'Owner');
      const candidates = await adapter.search('song', 'Song Artist'); assert.equal(candidates.length, 1); assert.equal(candidates[0].id, 'song'); assert.equal(candidates[0].durationMs, 180000);
      await adapter.createPlaylist('A playlist', 'Original description'); assert.equal(calls[0].args.privacyStatus, 'PRIVATE'); assert.equal(calls[0].args.description, 'Original description');
      await adapter.append('PLtest', ['song', 'song']); assert.deepEqual(calls[1].args.actions.map((a: any) => a.addedVideoId), ['song', 'song']);
      assert.deepEqual(await adapter.playlistItems('PLtest'), ['song', 'song']);
      await adapter.like('song'); assert.deepEqual(calls[2].args.target, { videoId: 'song' });
      await adapter.saveSong(candidates[0]); await adapter.saveSong(candidates[0]); assert.equal(saved, true);
      await adapter.saveAlbum('MPRalbum'); await adapter.saveAlbum('MPRalbum'); assert.equal(albumSaved, true);
      await adapter.followArtist('UCbrowse'); await adapter.followArtist('UCbrowse'); assert.equal(calls.filter(c => c.path === '/subscription/subscribe').length, 1); assert.deepEqual(calls.at(-1)!.args.channelIds, ['UCactual']);
    });
    test('Spotify reads every page and marks inaccessible playlists without pretending their contents transferred', async () => {
      const temp = await temporaryDirectory(); const store = new Store(temp.directory); const vault = new Vault(store); const originalFetch = globalThis.fetch; const visited: string[] = [];
      try {
        vault.set('spotify', { access_token: 'token', refresh_token: 'refresh', expires_at: Date.now() + 3600000, account: 'Owner', userId: 'owner' });
        globalThis.fetch = async (input: any) => {
          const url = String(input); visited.push(url);
          let data: any = { items: [], next: null }; let status = 200;
          if (url.includes('/me/playlists?')) data = { items: [{ id: 'owned', name: 'Owned', uri: 'spotify:playlist:owned' }], next: 'https://api.spotify.com/v1/me/playlists?offset=1' };
          if (url.includes('offset=1')) data = { items: [{ id: 'restricted', name: 'Restricted', uri: 'spotify:playlist:restricted' }], next: null };
          if (url.includes('/playlists/owned/items')) data = { items: [{ item: { type: 'track', name: 'Song', artists: [{ name: 'Artist' }], uri: 'spotify:track:one' } }], next: null };
          if (url.includes('/playlists/restricted/items')) status = 403;
          if (url.includes('/me/following')) data = { artists: { items: [], next: null } };
          return new Response(JSON.stringify(data), { status, headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' } });
        };
        const job = store.job('spotify_import', {}); await new SpotifyAdapter(store, vault).importAll(job.id, () => {});
        assert.equal(store.collections().length, 2); assert.equal(store.collections().find(c => c.name === 'Owned')!.count, 1); assert.equal(store.collections().find(c => c.name === 'Restricted')!.inaccessible, true);
        assert.equal(visited.some(url => url.includes('offset=1')), true); assert.equal(visited.some(url => url.includes('/me/tracks')), true);
      } finally { globalThis.fetch = originalFetch; store.close(); await temp.cleanup(); }
    });

    /**
     * Not a real renderer but we treat it as one to keep things organized.
     */
    export default class AccountItem extends YTNode {
        static type = 'AccountItem';
        account_name;
        account_photo;
        is_selected;
        is_disabled;
        has_channel;
        endpoint;
        account_byline;
        channel_handle;
        constructor(data) {
            super();
            this.account_name = new Text(data.accountName);
            this.account_photo = Thumbnail.fromResponse(data.accountPhoto);
            this.is_selected = !!data.isSelected;
            this.is_disabled = !!data.isDisabled;
            this.has_channel = !!data.hasChannel;
            this.endpoint = new NavigationEndpoint(data.serviceEndpoint);
            this.account_byline = new Text(data.accountByline);
            this.channel_handle = new Text(data.channelHandle);
        }
    }

    import { Parser } from '../index.js';
    import AccountItem from './AccountItem.js';
    import AccountItemSectionHeader from './AccountItemSectionHeader.js';
    import { YTNode } from '../helpers.js';
    import CompactLink from './CompactLink.js';
    export default class AccountItemSection extends YTNode {
        static type = 'AccountItemSection';
        contents;
        header;
        constructor(data) {
            super();
            this.contents = Parser.parseArray(data.contents, [AccountItem, CompactLink]);
            this.header = Parser.parseItem(data.header, AccountItemSectionHeader);
        }
    }

    import { test, mock } from 'node:test';
    import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
    import { Innertube } from 'youtubei.js';
    import { YouTubeAdapter, YouTubeFactory, YouTubeSessionError, ProviderError } from '../server/youtube.js';
    import { Store } from '../server/store.js';
    import { Vault } from '../server/security.js';
    import { createApp } from '../server/app.js';
    import { temporaryDirectory } from './helpers.js';
    
    const cookie = 'SAPISID=PRIVATE_COOKIE_VALUE; SID=PRIVATE_SESSION_VALUE';

      let transport: typeof fetch;
      const selected = { is_selected: true, has_channel: true, channel_handle: '@fixture', account_name: 'Fixture account' };
      const client: any = {
        account: { getInfo: async () => {
          await transport('https://www.youtube.com/youtubei/v1/account/accounts_list');
          return { contents: { contents: [selected] } };
        } },
        music: { getLibrary: async () => ({ contents: [], filters: [] }) },
      };
      const sdk = mock.method(Innertube, 'create', async (options: any) => { transport = options.fetch; return client; });
      return { client, sdk };
    }
    
    test('HTTP 200 signed-out responses become reconnect errors before the account parser runs', async () => {
      const fixture = sdkFixture();
      const network = mock.method(globalThis, 'fetch', async () => new Response(JSON.stringify({ responseContext: { mainAppWebResponseContext: { loggedOut: true } }, selectText: {} }), { headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' } }));
      try {
        await assert.rejects(() => YouTubeAdapter.connect(cookie), (error: any) => {
          assert.ok(error instanceof YouTubeSessionError); assert.equal(error.status, 401);
          assert.match(error.message, /signed out or expired/); assert.doesNotMatch(error.message, /PRIVATE|Page contents/); return true;
        });
      } finally { network.mock.restore(); fixture.sdk.mock.restore(); }
    });
    
    test('a valid session connects, a rejected session is flagged, and reconnect clears the flag', async () => {
      const temp = await temporaryDirectory(); const store = new Store(temp.directory); const vault = new Vault(store);
      const factory = new YouTubeFactory(vault); const fixture = sdkFixture(); let expired = true;
      const network = mock.method(globalThis, 'fetch', async () => new Response(JSON.stringify({ responseContext: { mainAppWebResponseContext: { loggedOut: expired } } }), { headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' } }));
      try {
        vault.set('youtube', { cookie, identity: '@fixture', account: 'Fixture account', accountIndex: 0 });
        await assert.rejects(() => factory.get(), YouTubeSessionError); assert.equal(factory.needsReconnect, true);
        expired = false;
        const provider = await factory.get(); assert.equal(provider.identity, '@fixture'); assert.equal(factory.needsReconnect, false);
        factory.clear(); assert.equal(factory.needsReconnect, false);
      } finally { network.mock.restore(); fixture.sdk.mock.restore(); store.close(); await temp.cleanup(); }
    });
    
    test('SDK status-code messages, structured errors, and network failures are categorized without leaking credentials', async () => {
      const errors = [
        { message: 'Request to https://www.youtube.com/youtubei/v1/browse failed with status code 401', expected: 401 },
        { message: 'Request failed', info: { error: { code: 403 } }, expected: 403 },
        { message: 'Request failed', info: JSON.stringify({ error: { code: 429 } }), expected: 429 },
        { name: 'TimeoutError', message: 'PRIVATE_COOKIE_VALUE', expected: 504 },
        { message: 'fetch failed', cause: { code: 'ENOTFOUND' }, expected: 503 },
      ];
      for (const error of errors) {
        const client: any = { music: { search: async () => { throw error; } } };
        await assert.rejects(() => new YouTubeAdapter(client, '@fixture', 'Fixture').search('song', 'Song'), (result: any) => {
          assert.ok(result instanceof ProviderError); assert.equal(result.status, error.expected); assert.doesNotMatch(result.message, /PRIVATE/); return true;
        });
      }
    });

    const selection = { collectionIds: [] as string[], likes: true, songs: false, albums: false, artists: false, favoriteIds: [] as string[] };
    const source: SourceEntity = { id: 'source', kind: 'song', name: 'Song', artists: ['Artist'], album: 'Album', durationMs: 180000 };
    const candidate: Candidate = { id: 'one', name: 'Song', artists: ['Artist'], album: 'Album', durationMs: 180000, url: 'https://music.youtube.com/watch?v=one' };
    
    test('best recording beats an unrelated first result; ties choose the first available result', () => {
      assert.equal(chooseMatch(source, [{ ...candidate, id: 'wrong', name: 'Other song', artists: ['Other'] }, candidate]).target!.id, 'one');
      assert.equal(chooseMatch(source, [candidate, { ...candidate, id: 'two' }]).target!.id, 'one');
      assert.equal(chooseMatch(source, [{ ...candidate, id: 'live', name: 'Song (Live)' }, candidate]).target!.id, 'one');
      assert.equal(chooseMatch(source, [{ ...candidate, available: false }, { ...candidate, id: 'available' }]).target!.id, 'available');
      assert.equal(chooseMatch(source, []).status, 'skipped');
    });
    
    test('1024 existing review candidates are accepted immediately without additional catalog searches', async () => {
      const temp = await temporaryDirectory(); const store = new Store(temp.directory);
      try {
        const ids = store.transaction(() => Array.from({ length: 1024 }, (_, index) => {
          const name = `Track ${index}`;
          const id = store.entity({ kind: 'song', name, artists: ['Artist'], uri: `spotify:track:${index}` });
          const candidates = [
            { id: `wrong-${index}`, name: 'Unrelated recording', artists: ['Other'], url: 'https://music.youtube.com/watch?v=wrong' },
            { id: `best-${index}`, name, artists: ['Artist'], url: `https://music.youtube.com/watch?v=best-${index}` },
          ];
          store.run("UPDATE entities SET status='review',candidates=? WHERE id=?", JSON.stringify(candidates), id); return id;
        }));
        const playlist = store.collection('backlog', { name: '1024 songs', description: '' }, [...ids, ids[0]]);
        const job = queueTransfer(store, { ...selection, collectionIds: [playlist], likes: false }, '@owner');
        assert.equal(job.kind, 'transfer');
        assert.equal(store.get("SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM entities WHERE status='matched'")!.n, 1024);
        const payload = JSON.parse(store.get('SELECT payload FROM jobs WHERE id=?', job.id)!.payload);
        assert.deepEqual(payload.sequences[playlist], [...ids.map((_, index) => `best-${index}`), 'best-0']);
        assert.equal(job.total, 1026);
      } finally { store.close(); await temp.cleanup(); }
    });

        assert.equal(response.statusCode, 200, response.body);

    export function selectedEntities(store: Store, selection: TransferSelection): string[] {

    function resolved(store: Store, kind: 'song' | 'album' | 'artist', name: string, target: string) {

    test('batch playlist transfer preserves repeated songs and performs native likes, saves, and subscriptions', async () => {
      const temp = await temporaryDirectory(); const store = new Store(join(temp.directory, 'data')); const provider = new FakeMusic(); const worker = new Worker(store, async () => provider);
      try {
        const a = resolved(store, 'song', 'First', 'a'); const b = resolved(store, 'song', 'Second', 'b'); resolved(store, 'album', 'Album', 'album'); resolved(store, 'artist', 'Artist', 'artist');
        const playlist = store.collection('test:playlist', { name: 'A playlist', description: 'Original description' }, [a, b, a]);
        const job = createTransfer(store, { ...selection, collectionIds: [playlist] }, provider.identity); await worker.tick();
        assert.equal(store.getJob(job.id)!.status, 'completed'); assert.deepEqual([...provider.playlists.values()][0].ids, ['a', 'b', 'a']);
        assert.equal(provider.calls.appends, 1); assert.equal(provider.likes.size, 2); assert.equal(provider.songs.size, 2); assert.equal(provider.albums.size, 1); assert.equal(provider.artists.size, 1);
        const repeat = createTransfer(store, { ...selection, collectionIds: [playlist] }, provider.identity); await worker.tick();
        assert.equal(store.getJob(repeat.id)!.status, 'completed'); assert.equal(provider.calls.creates, 1); assert.equal(provider.calls.appends, 1); assert.equal(provider.calls.likes, 2);
        assert.equal(store.all('SELECT * FROM steps WHERE job_id=?', job.id).length, job.total);
      } finally { await worker.stop(); store.close(); await temp.cleanup(); }
    });

    import 'dotenv/config';
    import { DatabaseSync } from 'node:sqlite';
    import { join } from 'node:path';
    import { config } from '../server/config.js';
    const db = new DatabaseSync(join(config.dataDir, 'encore.sqlite'), { readOnly: true });
    try {
      const jobs: any[] = db.prepare('SELECT id,kind,status,total,done,failed,skipped,message,payload FROM jobs ORDER BY created DESC LIMIT 6').all();
      for (const row of jobs) {
        const payload = JSON.parse(row.payload);
        console.log('Job:', { id: row.id, kind: row.kind, status: row.status, total: row.total, done: row.done, failed: row.failed, skipped: row.skipped, message: row.message });
        console.log('Operation totals:', db.prepare('SELECT kind,status,COUNT(*) count FROM steps WHERE job_id=? GROUP BY kind,status').all(row.id));
        if (row.kind !== 'transfer') continue;
        const ids = new Set<string>(); let occurrences = 0;
        for (const sequence of Object.values(payload.sequences || {}) as string[][]) { occurrences += sequence.length; }
        for (const step of db.prepare('SELECT kind,source_id FROM steps WHERE job_id=?').all(row.id) as any[]) {
          const source = JSON.parse(step.source_id); if (source.entity?.id) ids.add(source.entity.id); else if (source.kind) ids.add(source.id);
        }
        const pending: any = db.prepare("SELECT seq,kind,source_id FROM steps WHERE job_id=? AND status='pending' ORDER BY seq LIMIT 1").get(row.id);
        const item = pending?.kind === 'playlist_item' ? JSON.parse(pending.source_id) : undefined;
        const destination: any = item ? db.prepare("SELECT target,expected FROM destinations WHERE account=? AND kind='playlist' AND source_id=?").get(payload.account, item.collectionId) : undefined;
        const expected = destination ? JSON.parse(destination.expected) : [];
        const desired: string[] = item ? payload.sequences[item.collectionId] : [];
        console.log('Source and playlist counts:', { distinctSourceItems: ids.size, playlistOccurrences: occurrences, playlistCount: Object.keys(payload.sequences || {}).length });
        console.log('Next batch:', { seq: pending?.seq, operation: pending?.kind, collectionId: item?.collectionId, destinationIndex: item?.destinationIndex,
          confirmed: expected.length, desired: desired.length, first100Unique: new Set(desired.slice(0, 100)).size,
          firstBatchUnique: new Set(desired.slice(0, 50)).size, secondBatchUnique: new Set(desired.slice(50, 100)).size,
          repeatedAcrossFirstTwoBatches: desired.slice(50, 100).filter(id => desired.slice(0, 50).includes(id)).length,
          hasDestination: !!destination });
      }
    } finally { db.close(); }

    import 'dotenv/config';
    import { DatabaseSync } from 'node:sqlite';
    import { join } from 'node:path';
    import { config } from '../server/config.js';
    import { Vault } from '../server/security.js';
    import type { Store } from '../server/store.js';
    import { YouTubeAdapter, type YouTubeCredentials } from '../server/youtube.js';
    const db = new DatabaseSync(join(config.dataDir, 'encore.sqlite'), { readOnly: true });
    const vault = new Vault({ directory: config.dataDir, setting: (key: string) => (db.prepare('SELECT value FROM settings WHERE key=?').get(key) as { value?: string } | undefined)?.value } as Store);
    const credentials = vault.get<YouTubeCredentials>('youtube');
    const row: any = db.prepare("SELECT id,payload FROM jobs WHERE kind='transfer' AND status='needs_review' ORDER BY created DESC LIMIT 1").get();
    if (!credentials || !row) { db.close(); console.log('No saved session or paused transfer.'); process.exit(0); }
    const payload = JSON.parse(row.payload);
    const pending: any = db.prepare("SELECT source_id FROM steps WHERE job_id=? AND kind='playlist_item' AND status='pending' ORDER BY seq LIMIT 1").get(row.id);
    const source = JSON.parse(pending.source_id);
    const destination: any = db.prepare("SELECT target,expected FROM destinations WHERE account=? AND kind='playlist' AND source_id=?").get(payload.account, source.collectionId);
    const expected: string[] = JSON.parse(destination.expected); const desired: string[] = payload.sequences[source.collectionId];
    db.close();
    const { adapter } = await YouTubeAdapter.connect(credentials.cookie, credentials.accountIndex, credentials.channelId);
    if (adapter.identity !== payload.account) throw new Error('Connected channel differs from transfer.');
    const actual = await adapter.playlistItems(destination.target);
    let prefix = 0; while (prefix < actual.length && actual[prefix] === desired[prefix]) prefix++;
    const targetEnd = Math.min(source.destinationIndex + 50, desired.length);
    const deduped = [...new Set(desired.slice(0, targetEnd))];
    console.log('Destination comparison:', { confirmed: expected.length, pendingBatchStart: source.destinationIndex, intendedAfterAppend: targetEnd,
      actualCount: actual.length, commonPrefix: prefix, isDesiredPrefix: actual.every((id, index) => id === desired[index]),
      matchesDeduplicatedFirst100: actual.length === deduped.length && actual.every((id, index) => id === deduped[index]),
      unavailable: actual.filter(id => id === '__unavailable__').length,
      firstMismatchActualDesiredIndex: prefix < actual.length ? desired.indexOf(actual[prefix], prefix) : undefined,
      expectedPrefixIntact: expected.every((id, index) => actual[index] === id) });

        this.db.exec(`PRAGMA journal_mode=WAL; PRAGMA foreign_keys=ON; PRAGMA busy_timeout=5000;
          CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS settings (key TEXT PRIMARY KEY, value TEXT NOT NULL);
          CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sessions (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, csrf TEXT NOT NULL, expires INTEGER NOT NULL);
          CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS imports (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, sha TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL, name TEXT NOT NULL, created TEXT NOT NULL, stats TEXT NOT NULL);
          CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS entities (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, kind TEXT NOT NULL, name TEXT NOT NULL, body TEXT NOT NULL, status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', target TEXT, candidates TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', reason TEXT);
          CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS entity_kind ON entities(kind);
          CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS entity_status ON entities(status);
          CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS collections (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, source_key TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL, body TEXT NOT NULL);
          CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS entries (collection_id TEXT REFERENCES collections(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, position INTEGER NOT NULL, entity_id TEXT REFERENCES entities(id), PRIMARY KEY(collection_id,position));
          CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS history (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, entity_id TEXT REFERENCES entities(id), played_at TEXT NOT NULL, ms_played INTEGER NOT NULL, skipped INTEGER NOT NULL, source TEXT NOT NULL);
          CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS history_time ON history(played_at);
          CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS history_entity ON history(entity_id);
          CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS jobs (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, kind TEXT NOT NULL, status TEXT NOT NULL, payload TEXT NOT NULL, total INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, done INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, failed INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, skipped INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, message TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', created TEXT NOT NULL, updated TEXT NOT NULL);
          CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS steps (job_id TEXT REFERENCES jobs(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, seq INTEGER NOT NULL, kind TEXT NOT NULL, source_id TEXT NOT NULL, status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', reason TEXT, url TEXT, PRIMARY KEY(job_id,seq));
          CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS destinations (account TEXT NOT NULL, kind TEXT NOT NULL, source_id TEXT NOT NULL, target TEXT NOT NULL, expected TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', PRIMARY KEY(account,kind,source_id));
          PRAGMA user_version=1;`);
      }
      run(sql: string, ...params: any[]) { return this.db.prepare(sql).run(...params); }
      get(sql: string, ...params: any[]): Row | undefined { return this.db.prepare(sql).get(...params) as Row | undefined; }
      all(sql: string, ...params: any[]): Row[] { return this.db.prepare(sql).all(...params) as Row[]; }

    def add_playlist_items(
            self,
            playlistId: str,
            videoIds: list[str] | None = None,
            source_playlist: str | None = None,
            duplicates: bool = False,
        ) -> str | JsonDict:
            """
            Add songs to an existing playlist
    
            :param playlistId: Playlist id
            :param videoIds: List of Video ids
            :param source_playlist: Playlist id of a playlist to add to the current playlist (no duplicate check)
            :param duplicates: If True, duplicates will be added. If False, an error will be returned if there are duplicates (no items are added to the playlist)
            :return: Status String and a dict containing the new setVideoId for each videoId or full response
            """
            self._check_auth()
            body: JsonDict = {"playlistId": validate_playlist_id(playlistId), "actions": []}
            if not videoIds and not source_playlist:
                raise YTMusicUserError(
                    "You must provide either videoIds or a source_playlist to add to the playlist"
                )
    
            if videoIds:
                for videoId in videoIds:
                    action = {"action": "ACTION_ADD_VIDEO", "addedVideoId": videoId}
                    if duplicates:
                        action["dedupeOption"] = "DEDUPE_OPTION_SKIP"
                    body["actions"].append(action)
    
            if source_playlist:
                body["actions"].append({"action": "ACTION_ADD_PLAYLIST", "addedFullListId": source_playlist})
    
                # add an empty ACTION_ADD_VIDEO because otherwise
                # YTM doesn't return the dict that maps videoIds to their new setVideoIds
                if not videoIds:
                    body["actions"].append({"action": "ACTION_ADD_VIDEO", "addedVideoId": None})
    
            endpoint = "browse/edit_playlist"
            response = self._send_request(endpoint, body)
            if "status" in response and "SUCCEEDED" in response["status"]:
                result_dict = [
                    result_data.get("playlistEditVideoAddedResultData")
                    for result_data in response.get("playlistEditResults", [])
                ]
                return {"status": response["status"], "playlistEditResults": result_dict}
            else:
                return response
    
        def remove_playlist_items(self, playlistId: str, videos: JsonList) -> str | JsonDict:
            """
            Remove songs from an existing playlist
    
            :param playlistId: Playlist id
            :param videos: List of PlaylistItems, see :py:func:`get_playlist`.
                Must contain videoId and setVideoId
            :return: Status String or full response
            """
            self._check_auth()
            videos = list(filter(lambda x: "videoId" in x and "setVideoId" in x, videos))
            if len(videos) == 0:
                raise YTMusicUserError(
                    "Cannot remove songs, because setVideoId is missing. Do you own this playlist?"
                )
    
            body: JsonDict = {"playlistId": validate_playlist_id(playlistId), "actions": []}
            for video in videos:
                body["actions"].append(
                    {
                        "setVideoId": video["setVideoId"],
                        "removedVideoId": video["videoId"],
                        "action": "ACTION_REMOVE_VIDEO",
                    }
                )
    
            endpoint = "browse/edit_playlist"
            response = self._send_request(endpoint, body)
            result: str | JsonDict = response.get("status", response)
            return result

    import { test } from 'node:test';
    import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
    import { Store } from '../server/store.js';
    import { createTransfer, Worker } from '../server/worker.js';
    import { YouTubeAdapter, ProviderError } from '../server/youtube.js';
    import { FakeMusic, temporaryDirectory } from './helpers.js';
    
    const selection = { collectionIds: [] as string[], likes: false, songs: false, albums: false, artists: false, favoriteIds: [] as string[] };
    function matched(store: Store, name: string, video: string, flags = {}) {
      const id = store.entity({ kind: 'song', name, artists: ['Artist'], ...flags });
      store.run("UPDATE entities SET status='matched',target=? WHERE id=?", JSON.stringify({ id: video, name, artists: ['Artist'], url: `https://music.youtube.com/watch?v=${video}` }), id);
      return id;
    }
    
    test('a repeated recording across the second batch does not reject a 120-song transfer', async () => {
      const temp = await temporaryDirectory(); const store = new Store(temp.directory); let ids: string[] = []; let appends = 0;
      const client: any = {
        actions: { execute: async (path: string, body: any) => {
          if (path === '/playlist/create') return { success: true, data: { playlistId: 'playlist' } };
          assert.equal(path, '/browse/edit_playlist'); appends++;
          // YouTube's real behavior: reject the entire batch on an existing recording,
          // unless each action explicitly skips the duplicate check.
          if (body.actions.some((action: any) => ids.includes(action.addedVideoId) && action.dedupeOption !== 'DEDUPE_OPTION_SKIP')) return { success: true, status_code: 200, data: { status: 'STATUS_FAILED' } };
          ids.push(...body.actions.map((action: any) => action.addedVideoId));
          return { success: true, data: { status: 'STATUS_SUCCEEDED' } };
        } },
        music: { getPlaylist: async () => ({ items: ids.map(id => ({ id })), has_continuation: false }) },
      };
      const provider = new YouTubeAdapter(client, '@owner', 'Owner'); const worker = new Worker(store, async () => provider);
      try {
        const desired = Array.from({ length: 120 }, (_, index) => `video-${index === 70 ? 20 : index}`);
        const entities = desired.map((video, index) => matched(store, `Song ${index}`, video));
        const playlist = store.collection('repeated-recording', { name: 'My playlist', description: '' }, entities);
        const job = createTransfer(store, { ...selection, collectionIds: [playlist] }, provider.identity); await worker.tick();
        assert.equal(store.getJob(job.id)!.status, 'completed', store.getJob(job.id)!.message);
        assert.equal(store.getJob(job.id)!.done, 121); assert.equal(appends, 3); assert.deepEqual(ids, desired);
      } finally { await worker.stop(); store.close(); await temp.cleanup(); }
    });
    
    test('an HTTP 200 failed playlist status is rejected rather than treated as a successful append', async () => {
      const client: any = { actions: { execute: async () => ({ success: true, status_code: 200, data: { status: 'STATUS_FAILED' } }) } };
      await assert.rejects(() => new YouTubeAdapter(client, '@owner', 'Owner').append('playlist', ['video']), (error: any) => error instanceof ProviderError && error.status === 502);
    });
    
    test('delayed playlist reads are polled without appending the same songs again', async () => {
      const temp = await temporaryDirectory(); const store = new Store(temp.directory); const provider = new FakeMusic();
      const read = provider.playlistItems.bind(provider); const append = provider.append.bind(provider);
      let stale: string[] = []; let reads = 0;
      provider.append = async (id, ids) => { stale = await read(id); await append(id, ids); reads = 2; };
      provider.playlistItems = async id => reads-- > 0 ? [...stale] : read(id);
      const worker = new Worker(store, async () => provider);
      try {
        const song = matched(store, 'Song', 'video'); const playlist = store.collection('delayed', { name: 'Delayed reads', description: '' }, [song, song]);
        const job = createTransfer(store, { ...selection, collectionIds: [playlist] }, provider.identity); await worker.tick();
        assert.equal(store.getJob(job.id)!.status, 'completed'); assert.equal(provider.calls.appends, 1);
        assert.deepEqual([...provider.playlists.values()][0].ids, ['video', 'video']);
      } finally { await worker.stop(); store.close(); await temp.cleanup(); }
    });
    
    test('real unexpected destination edits still pause without overwriting or further appends', async () => {
      const temp = await temporaryDirectory(); const store = new Store(temp.directory); const provider = new FakeMusic();
      const append = provider.append.bind(provider);
      provider.append = async (id, ids) => { await append(id, ids); provider.playlists.get(id)!.ids.unshift('external-song'); };
      const worker = new Worker(store, async () => provider);
      try {
        const song = matched(store, 'Song', 'video'); const playlist = store.collection('external', { name: 'External edit', description: '' }, [song]);
        const job = createTransfer(store, { ...selection, collectionIds: [playlist] }, provider.identity); await worker.tick();
        assert.equal(store.getJob(job.id)!.status, 'needs_review'); assert.equal(provider.calls.appends, 1);
        assert.deepEqual([...provider.playlists.values()][0].ids, ['external-song', 'video']);
      } finally { await worker.stop(); store.close(); await temp.cleanup(); }
    });
    
    test('existing saved jobs expose source counts separately from playlist/like/save actions', async () => {
      const temp = await temporaryDirectory(); let store = new Store(temp.directory);
      try {
        const song = matched(store, 'Song', 'video', { liked: true, saved: true });
        const playlist = store.collection('counts', { name: 'Count repeated items', description: '' }, [song, song]);
        const job = createTransfer(store, { ...selection, collectionIds: [playlist], likes: true, songs: true }, '@owner');
        assert.equal(job.total, 5); assert.equal(job.summary!.sourceItems, 1); assert.equal(job.summary!.playlistEntries, 2);
        const payload = JSON.parse(store.get('SELECT payload FROM jobs WHERE id=?', job.id)!.payload); delete payload.summary;
        store.run('UPDATE jobs SET payload=? WHERE id=?', JSON.stringify(payload), job.id);
        store.close(); store = new Store(temp.directory);
        assert.deepEqual(store.getJob(job.id)!.summary, { sourceItems: 1, playlists: 1, playlistEntries: 2, likes: 1, savedSongs: 1, albums: 0, artists: 0 });
      } finally { store.close(); await temp.cleanup(); }
    });

    const base = 'http://127.0.0.1:8080';
    const id = 'c38a31f3-cde6-4bb6-afaa-1a909a152f10';
    const sessionResponse = await fetch(`${base}/api/auth/status`);
    const session = await sessionResponse.json();
    const headers = { cookie: sessionResponse.headers.get('set-cookie')?.split(';')[0] || '', 'x-csrf-token': session.csrf };
    async function current() {
      const response = await fetch(`${base}/api/jobs?pageSize=30`, { headers });
      if (!response.ok) throw new Error(`Job read failed: ${response.status}`);
      return (await response.json()).items.find(job => job.id === id);
    }
    const before = await current();
    if (!before) throw new Error('The requested paused job was not found.');
    console.log('Existing transfer:', { status: before.status, done: before.done, total: before.total, summary: before.summary });
    if (before.status === 'needs_review' && before.message.includes('unexpected playlist contents after an append')) {
      const response = await fetch(`${base}/api/jobs/${id}/resume`, { method: 'POST', headers });
      if (!response.ok) throw new Error(`Resume failed: ${response.status}`);
      console.log('Resumed the existing transfer from its saved checkpoint.');
    } else if (!['queued', 'running'].includes(before.status)) {
      console.log('Job is no longer at the expected recovery point; left unchanged.'); process.exit(0);
    }
    let last = '';
    for (let attempt = 0; attempt < 20; attempt++) {
      await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 2000));
      const job = await current(); const state = `${job.status}:${job.done}:${job.failed}`;
      if (state !== last) { console.log('Progress:', { status: job.status, done: job.done, failed: job.failed, skipped: job.skipped, pending: job.total - job.done - job.failed - job.skipped, message: job.message }); last = state; }
      if (job.done >= 121 && job.status === 'running') { console.log('Verified: the existing job passed its original stopping point and completed the first playlist.'); break; }
      if (!['queued', 'running'].includes(job.status)) break;
    }

    let csrf = '';
    let reopening: Promise<void> | undefined;
    export const setCsrf = (value: string) => { csrf = value; };
    export class ApiError extends Error {
      constructor(message: string, readonly code?: string) { super(message); }
    }
    export async function api<T = any>(path: string, options: { method?: string; body?: unknown; signal?: AbortSignal } = {}, retried = false): Promise<T> {
      const headers: Record<string, string> = {};
      let body: BodyInit | undefined;
      if (options.body instanceof FormData) body = options.body;
      else if (options.body !== undefined) { body = JSON.stringify(options.body); headers['Content-Type'] = 'application/json'; }
      if (options.method && options.method !== 'GET') headers['x-csrf-token'] = csrf;
      const response = await fetch(path, { method: options.method || 'GET', headers, body, credentials: 'same-origin', signal: options.signal });
      let data: any;
      try { data = await response.json(); }
      catch { throw new Error('The server is unavailable. Make sure Encore is running, then try again.'); }
      if (!response.ok) {
        if (!retried && response.status === 401 && !path.startsWith('/api/auth/')) {
          reopening ??= api<{ csrf: string }>('/api/auth/status').then(session => setCsrf(session.csrf)).finally(() => { reopening = undefined; });
          await reopening;
          return api<T>(path, options, true);
        }
        throw new ApiError(data.error || 'The request could not be completed.', data.code);
      }
      return data;
    }

    export default function App() {
      const [ready, setReady] = useState(false);
      const [error, setError] = useState('');
      const opening = useRef<Promise<{ csrf: string }> | undefined>(undefined);
      useEffect(() => {
        opening.current ??= api('/api/auth/status');
        opening.current.then(data => { setCsrf(data.csrf); setReady(true); }).catch(e => setError(errorMessage(e)));
      }, []);
      if (!ready) return <div className="boot"><Brand/><p>{error || <><Spinner/> Opening your music workspaceâ€¦</>}</p>{error && <button className="btn" onClick={() => location.reload()}>Try again</button>}</div>;
      return <Workspace/>;
    }
    
    function Workspace() {

      const [selected, setSelected] = useState<Set<string>>(new Set()); const known = useRef(new Set<string>());

        if (results[0].status === 'fulfilled') setOverview(results[0].value);
        if (results[1].status === 'fulfilled') setConnections(results[1].value);

          setSelected(old => { const next = new Set([...old].filter(id => list.some(c => c.id === id))); for (const id of added) next.add(id); return next; });
          known.current = new Set(list.map(c => c.id));
        }
        for (const result of results) if (result.status === 'rejected') { setNotice({ text: errorMessage(result.reason), error: true }); break; }
        refreshBusy.current = false;
      };
      useEffect(() => { void refresh(); const timer = setInterval(() => void refresh(), 2500); return () => clearInterval(timer); }, []);

      };

        { id: 'transfers', name: 'Transfers', icon: <ArrowRightLeft size={19}/> },

      return <div className="app-shell"><aside className={`sidebar ${mobileNav ?       const network = mock.method(globalThis, 'fetch', async () => { if (++calls === 1) throw new TypeError('Failed to fetch'); return json({ healthy: true }); });
      try { assert.deepEqual(await api('/api/overview'), { healthy: true }); assert.equal(calls, 2); }
      finally { network.mock.restore(); }
    });
    
    test('a persistent outage stops retrying with a recognizable connection error', async () => {
      const network = mock.method(globalThis, 'fetch', async () => new Response('', { status: 503 }));
      try {
        await assert.rejects(api('/api/overview'), (error: any) => error instanceof ApiError && error.code === 'SERVER_UNAVAILABLE');
        assert.equal(network.mock.callCount(), 4);
      } finally { network.mock.restore(); }
    });
    
    test('transfer writes are never repeated after an uncertain network or proxy response', async () => {
      for (const failure of ['network', 'proxy']) {
        setCsrf('test-csrf');
        const network = mock.method(globalThis, 'fetch', async (_path: any, options: any) => {
          assert.equal(options.method, 'POST'); assert.equal(options.headers['x-csrf-token'], 'test-csrf');
          if (failure === 'network') throw new TypeError('Failed to fetch');
          return new Response('Bad gateway', { status: 502 });
        });
        try {
          await assert.rejects(api('/api/transfers', { method: 'POST', body: {} }), (error: any) => error instanceof ApiError && error.code === 'SERVER_UNAVAILABLE' && /Check Transfers/.test(error.message));
          assert.equal(network.mock.callCount(), 1);
        } finally { network.mock.restore(); }
      }
    });
    
    test('aborting a read cancels its retry and preserves the abort reason', async () => {
      const controller = new AbortController();
      const network = mock.method(globalThis, 'fetch', async () => { queueMicrotask(() => controller.abort()); throw new TypeError('Failed to fetch'); });
      try {
        await assert.rejects(api('/api/overview', { signal: controller.signal }), (error: any) => error === controller.signal.reason && error.name === 'AbortError');
        assert.equal(network.mock.callCount(), 1);
      } finally { network.mock.restore(); }
    });
    
    test('provider errors remain actionable without being retried as server outages', async () => {
      const network = mock.method(globalThis, 'fetch', async () => json({ error: 'Reconnect YouTube Music.', code: 'YOUTUBE_RECONNECT_REQUIRED' }, 409));
      try {
        await assert.rejects(api('/api/connections'), (error: any) => error instanceof ApiError && error.code === 'YOUTUBE_RECONNECT_REQUIRED');
        assert.equal(network.mock.callCount(), 1);
      } finally { network.mock.restore(); }
    });
    
    test('expired local sessions reopen before retrying the authorized write', async () => {
      setCsrf('old-csrf'); let calls = 0;
      const network = mock.method(globalThis, 'fetch', async (path: any, options: any) => {
        calls++;
        if (calls === 1) return json({ error: 'Session expired.' }, 401);
        if (calls === 2) { assert.equal(path, '/api/auth/status'); return json({ csrf: 'new-csrf' }); }
        assert.equal(options.headers['x-csrf-token'], 'new-csrf'); return json({ resumed: true });
      });
      try { assert.deepEqual(await api('/api/jobs/existing/resume', { method: 'POST' }), { resumed: true }); assert.equal(calls, 3); }
      finally { network.mock.restore(); }
    });

    export const setCsrf = (value: string) => { csrf = value; };
    export class ApiError extends Error {
      constructor(message: string, readonly code?: string) { super(message); }

    function pause(milliseconds: number, signal?: AbortSignal) {
      return new Promise<void>((resolve, reject) => {
        const abort = () => { clearTimeout(timer); reject(signal?.reason); };
        const timer = setTimeout(() => { signal?.removeEventListener('abort', abort); resolve(); }, milliseconds);
        signal?.addEventListener('abort', abort, { once: true });
        if (signal?.aborted) abort();
      });
    }
    export async function api<T = any>(path: string, options: { method?: string; body?: unknown; signal?: AbortSignal } = {}, retried = false): Promise<T> {
      const method = (options.method || 'GET').toUpperCase();
      const headers: Record<string, string> = {};
      let body: BodyInit | undefined;
      if (options.body instanceof FormData) body = options.body;
      else if (options.body !== undefined) { body = JSON.stringify(options.body); headers['Content-Type'] = 'application/json'; }
      if (method !== 'GET') headers['x-csrf-token'] = csrf;
      let response!: Response;
      let data: any;
      const delays = [500, 1000, 2000];
      for (let attempt = 0; ; attempt++) {
        try {
          response = await fetch(path, { method, headers, body, credentials: 'same-origin', signal: options.signal });
          data = await response.json();
          break;
        } catch (error) {
          if (options.signal?.aborted) throw options.signal.reason;
          if (error instanceof Error && error.name === 'AbortError') throw error;
          if (response && !response.ok && response.status < 500) throw new ApiError('Encore returned an unreadable response. Try again.', 'INVALID_RESPONSE');
          if (method !== 'GET' || attempt === delays.length) throw new ApiError(method === 'GET'
            ? 'Connection to Encore was interrupted. Reconnectingâ€¦'
            : 'Could not reach Encore. Check Transfers before trying this action again.', 'SERVER_UNAVAILABLE');
          await pause(delays[attempt], options.signal);
        }
      }
      if (!response.ok) {
        if (!retried && response.status === 401 && !path.startsWith('/api/auth/')) {
          reopening ??= api<{ csrf: string }>('/api/auth/status').then(session => setCsrf(session.csrf)).finally(() => { reopening = undefined; });
          await reopening;
          return api<T>(path, options, true);
        }
        throw new ApiError(data?.error || 'The request could not be completed.', data?.code);
      }
      return data;
    }

    try {

      for (const row of jobs) {
