        console.log('Job:', { id: row.id, kind: row.kind, status: row.status, total: row.total, done: row.done, failed: row.failed, skipped: row.skipped, message: row.message });
        console.log('Operation totals:', db.prepare('SELECT kind,status,COUNT(*) count FROM steps WHERE job_id=? GROUP BY kind,status').all(row.id));
        if (row.kind !== 'transfer') continue;
        const ids = new Set<string>(); let occurrences = 0;
        for (const sequence of Object.values(payload.sequences || {}) as string[][]) { occurrences += sequence.length; }
        for (const step of db.prepare('SELECT kind,source_id FROM steps WHERE job_id=?').all(row.id) as any[]) {
          const source = JSON.parse(step.source_id); if (source.entity?.id) ids.add(source.entity.id); else if (source.kind) ids.add(source.id);
        }
        const pending: any = db.prepare("SELECT seq,kind,source_id FROM steps WHERE job_id=? AND status='pending' ORDER BY seq LIMIT 1").get(row.id);
        const item = pending?.kind === 'playlist_item' ? JSON.parse(pending.source_id) : undefined;
        const destination: any = item ? db.prepare("SELECT target,expected FROM destinations WHERE account=? AND kind='playlist' AND source_id=?").get(payload.account, item.collectionId) : undefined;
        const expected = destination ? JSON.parse(destination.expected) : [];
        const desired: string[] = item ? payload.sequences[item.collectionId] : [];
        console.log('Source and playlist counts:', { distinctSourceItems: ids.size, playlistOccurrences: occurrences, playlistCount: Object.keys(payload.sequences || {}).length });
        console.log('Next batch:', { seq: pending?.seq, operation: pending?.kind, collectionId: item?.collectionId, destinationIndex: item?.destinationIndex,
          confirmed: expected.length, desired: desired.length, first100Unique: new Set(desired.slice(0, 100)).size,
          firstBatchUnique: new Set(desired.slice(0, 50)).size, secondBatchUnique: new Set(desired.slice(50, 100)).size,
          repeatedAcrossFirstTwoBatches: desired.slice(50, 100).filter(id => desired.slice(0, 50).includes(id)).length,
          hasDestination: !!destination });
      }
    } finally { db.close(); }

      playlists = new Map<string, { name: string; description: string; ids: string[] }>();
      likes = new Set<string>(); songs = new Set<string>(); albums = new Set<string>(); artists = new Set<string>();
      calls = { creates: 0, appends: 0, likes: 0, songs: 0, albums: 0, artists: 0 };
      failAfterAppend = false; failAfterCreate = false; searchError?: ProviderError;
      async search(kind: EntityKind, query: string): Promise<Candidate[]> {
        if (this.searchError) throw this.searchError;
        return [{ id: `yt-${kind}`, name: 'Song', artists: ['Artist'], url: 'https://music.youtube.com/watch?v=test', album: 'Album' }];
      }
      async findPlaylist(marker: string) { return [...this.playlists].find(([, p]) => p.description.includes(marker))?.[0]; }
      async createPlaylist(name: string, description: string) {
        this.calls.creates++; const id = `playlist-${this.calls.creates}`; this.playlists.set(id, { name, description, ids: [] });
        if (this.failAfterCreate) { this.failAfterCreate = false; throw new ProviderError('Simulated lost creation response.', 502); } return id;
      }
      async playlistItems(id: string) { return [...this.playlists.get(id)!.ids]; }
      async append(id: string, ids: string[]) {
        this.calls.appends++; this.playlists.get(id)!.ids.push(...ids);
        if (this.failAfterAppend) { this.failAfterAppend = false; throw new ProviderError('Simulated lost append response.', 502); }
      }
      async like(id: string) { this.calls.likes++; this.likes.add(id); }
      async saveSong(candidate: Candidate) { this.calls.songs++; this.songs.add(candidate.id); }
      async saveAlbum(id: string) { this.calls.albums++; this.albums.add(id); }
      async followArtist(id: string) { this.calls.artists++; this.artists.add(id); }
    }

    export class Store {

        this.db.exec(`PRAGMA journal_mode=WAL; PRAGMA foreign_keys=ON; PRAGMA busy_timeout=5000;
          CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS settings (key TEXT PRIMARY KEY, value TEXT NOT NULL);
          CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sessions (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, csrf TEXT NOT NULL, expires INTEGER NOT NULL);
          CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS imports (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, sha TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL, name TEXT NOT NULL, created TEXT NOT NULL, stats TEXT NOT NULL);
          CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS entities (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, kind TEXT NOT NULL, name TEXT NOT NULL, body TEXT NOT NULL, status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', target TEXT, candidates TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', reason TEXT);
          CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS entity_kind ON entities(kind);
          CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS entity_status ON entities(status);
          CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS collections (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, source_key TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL, body TEXT NOT NULL);
          CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS entries (collection_id TEXT REFERENCES collections(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, position INTEGER NOT NULL, entity_id TEXT REFERENCES entities(id), PRIMARY KEY(collection_id,position));
          CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS history (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, entity_id TEXT REFERENCES entities(id), played_at TEXT NOT NULL, ms_played INTEGER NOT NULL, skipped INTEGER NOT NULL, source TEXT NOT NULL);
          CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS history_time ON history(played_at);
          CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS history_entity ON history(entity_id);
          CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS jobs (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, kind TEXT NOT NULL, status TEXT NOT NULL, payload TEXT NOT NULL, total INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, done INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, failed INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, skipped INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, message TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', created TEXT NOT NULL, updated TEXT NOT NULL);
          CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS steps (job_id TEXT REFERENCES jobs(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, seq INTEGER NOT NULL, kind TEXT NOT NULL, source_id TEXT NOT NULL, status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', reason TEXT, url TEXT, PRIMARY KEY(job_id,seq));
          CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS destinations (account TEXT NOT NULL, kind TEXT NOT NULL, source_id TEXT NOT NULL, target TEXT NOT NULL, expected TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', PRIMARY KEY(account,kind,source_id));
          PRAGMA user_version=1;`);
      }
      run(sql: string, ...params: any[]) { return this.db.prepare(sql).run(...params); }
      get(sql: string, ...params: any[]): Row | undefined { return this.db.prepare(sql).get(...params) as Row | undefined; }
      all(sql: string, ...params: any[]): Row[] { return this.db.prepare(sql).all(...params) as Row[]; }
      transaction<T>(fn: () => T): T {
        this.db.exec('BEGIN IMMEDIATE');

        const existing = this.get('SELECT body FROM entities WHERE id=?', id);
        const old: Partial<SourceEntity> = existing ? JSON.parse(existing.body) : {};
        const body = { ...old, ...Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(source).filter(([, value]) => value !== undefined)), id,

        return id;

      getEntity(id: string): EntityView | undefined { const row = this.get('SELECT * FROM entities WHERE id=?', id); return row ? this.entityView(row) : undefined; }
      collection(sourceKey: string, body: Omit<Collection, 'id' | 'count'>, entityIds: string[]): string {
        const existing = this.get('SELECT id FROM collections WHERE source_key=?', sourceKey);
        const id = existing?.id || hash(sourceKey);
        this.transaction(() => {
          this.run('INSERT INTO collections VALUES (?,?,?) ON CONFLICT(id) DO UPDATE SET body=excluded.body', id, sourceKey, JSON.stringify({ ...body, id, count: entityIds.length }));
          this.run('DELETE FROM entries WHERE collection_id=?', id);
          const stmt = this.db.prepare('INSERT INTO entries VALUES (?,?,?)');
          entityIds.forEach((entityId, position) => stmt.run(id, position, entityId));
        });
        return id;
      }
      collections(): Collection[] { return this.all('SELECT body FROM collections ORDER BY rowid').map(row => JSON.parse(row.body)); }
      job(kind: Job['kind'], payload: unknown, steps: { kind: string; sourceId: string }[] = []): Job {
        const id = randomUUID(); const timestamp = now();
        this.transaction(() => {
          this.run('INSERT INTO jobs(id,kind,status,payload,total,created,updated) VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?)', id, kind, 'queued', JSON.stringify(payload), steps.length, timestamp, timestamp);
          steps.forEach((step, seq) => this.run('INSERT INTO steps(job_id,seq,kind,source_id) VALUES (?,?,?,?)', id, seq, step.kind, step.sourceId));
        });
        return this.getJob(id)!;
      }
      jobView(row: Row): Job {

        if (row.kind === 'transfer') {
          summary = this.summaryCache.get(row.id);
          if (!summary) {
            summary = JSON.parse(row.payload).summary;
            if (!summary) {
              // Backfill older job views without modifying their saved transfer plans.
              const counts = Object.fromEntries(this.all('SELECT kind,COUNT(*) n FROM steps WHERE job_id=? GROUP BY kind', row.id).map(item => [item.kind, item.n]));
              const sourceItems = this.get("SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(json_extract(source_id,'$.entity.id'),json_extract(source_id,'$.id'))) n FROM steps WHERE job_id=? AND kind!='playlist'", row.id)!.n;
              summary = { sourceItems, playlists: counts.playlist || 0, playlistEntries: counts.playlist_item || 0,
                likes: counts.like || 0, savedSongs: counts.song || 0, albums: counts.album || 0, artists: counts.artist || 0 };
            }
            this.summaryCache.set(row.id, summary!);
          }
        }
        return { id: row.id, kind: row.kind, status: row.status, total: row.total, done: row.done, failed: row.failed, skipped: row.skipped,
          message: row.message, createdAt: row.created, updatedAt: row.updated, ...(summary ? { summary } : {}) };
      }
      getJob(id: string): Job | undefined { const row = this.get('SELECT * FROM jobs WHERE id=?', id); return row ? this.jobView(row) : undefined; }
      updateJob(id: string, status: JobStatus, message?: string) {
        this.run('UPDATE jobs SET status=?,message=COALESCE(?,message),updated=? WHERE id=?', status, message ?? null, now(), id);
      }
      stepResult(jobId: string, seq: number, status: string, reason?: string, url?: string) {
        this.transaction(() => {
          this.run('UPDATE steps SET status=?,reason=?,url=? WHERE job_id=? AND seq=?', status, reason || null, url || null, jobId, seq);
          const counts = this.get("SELECT SUM(status='done') AS done,SUM(status='failed') AS failed,SUM(status='skipped') AS skipped FROM steps WHERE job_id=?", jobId)!;
          this.run('UPDATE jobs SET done=?,failed=?,skipped=?,updated=? WHERE id=?', counts.done || 0, counts.failed || 0, counts.skipped || 0, now(), jobId);
        });
      }
      close() { this.db.close(); }
    }

    # Full-Story Verification
    
    You are a verification orchestrator. Your job is not to run a single check â€” it is to **infer the complete user story** being built and verify every boundary in the flow with evidence.
    
    Your focus is the **end-to-end story**, not any single layer.
    
    ## When This Triggers
    
    - A dev server just started and the user wants to know if things work
    - The user says something "isn't quite right" or "almost works"
    - The user asks you to verify a feature or check the full flow
    
    ## Step 1 â€” Infer the User Story
    
    Before checking anything, determine **what is being built**:
    
    1. Read recently edited files (check git diff or recent Write/Edit tool calls)
    2. Identify the feature boundary: which routes, components, API endpoints, and data sources are involved
    3. Scan `package.json` scripts, route structure (`app/` or `pages/`), and environment files (`.env*`)
    4. State the story in one sentence: _"The user is building [X] which flows from [UI entry point] â†’ [API route] â†’ [data source] â†’ [response rendering]"_
    
    **Do not skip this step.** Every subsequent check must be anchored to the inferred story.
    
    ## Step 2 â€” Establish Evidence Baseline
    
    Gather the current state across all layers:
    
    | Layer | How to check | What to capture |
    |-------|-------------|-----------------|
    | **Browser** | Open the relevant page, check console, take screenshots | Visual state, console errors, network failures |
    | **Server terminal** | Read the terminal output from the dev server process | Startup errors, request logs, compilation warnings |
    | **Runtime logs** | Run `vercel logs` (if deployed) or check server stdout | API response codes, error traces, timing |
    | **Environment** | Check `.env.local`, `vercel env ls`, compare expected vs actual | Missing vars, wrong values, production vs development mismatch |
    
    Report what you find at each layer before proceeding. Use this reporting contract:
    
    > **Checking**: [what you're looking at]
    > **Evidence**: [what you found â€” quote actual output]
    > **Next**: [what this means for the next step]
    
    ## Step 3 â€” Walk the Data Flow
    
    Trace the feature's data path from trigger to completion:
    
    1. **UI trigger** â€” What user action initiates the flow? (button click, page load, form submit)
    2. **Client â†’ Server** â€” What request is made? Check the fetch/action call, verify the URL, method, and payload match the API route
    3. **API route handler** â€” Read the route file. Does it handle the method? Does it validate input? Does it call the right service/database?
    4. **External dependencies** â€” If the route calls a database, third-party API, or Vercel service (KV, Blob, Postgres, AI SDK): verify the client is initialized, credentials are present, and the call shape matches the SDK docs
    5. **Response â†’ UI** â€” Does the response format match what the client expects? Is error handling present on both sides?
    
    At each boundary, check for these common breaks:
    - **Missing `await`** on async operations
    - **Wrong HTTP method** (GET handler but POST fetch)
    - **Env var absent** in runtime but present in `.env.local`
    - **Import mismatch** (server module imported in client component or vice versa)
    - **Type mismatch** between API response and client expectation
    - **Missing error boundary** â€” unhandled rejection crashes the page silently
    
    ## Step 4 â€” Report With Evidence
    
    Summarize findings in a structured report:
    
    ```
    ## Verification Report: [Feature Name]

    export function passwordHash(password: string): string {
      const salt = randomBytes(16).toString('hex');
      return `${salt}:${scryptSync(password, salt, 64).toString('hex')}`;
    }
    export function verifyPassword(password: string, encoded: string): boolean {
      const [salt, value] = encoded.split(':');
      const expected = Buffer.from(value, 'hex'); const actual = scryptSync(password, salt, 64);
      return expected.length === actual.length && timingSafeEqual(expected, actual);
    }
    export class Vault {
      private readonly key: Buffer;
      constructor(private readonly store: Store) {
        if (process.env.ENCRYPTION_KEY) this.key = Buffer.from(process.env.ENCRYPTION_KEY, 'base64');
        else {
          const path = join(store.directory, 'encryption.key');
          try { this.key = readFileSync(path); }
          catch (error: any) {
            if (error.code !== 'ENOENT') throw error;
            const key = randomBytes(32); writeFileSync(path, key, { mode: 0o600, flag: 'wx' }); this.key = key;
          }
        }
        if (this.key.length !== 32) throw new Error('ENCRYPTION_KEY must be a base64-encoded 32-byte key.');
      }
      encrypt(value: unknown): string {
        const iv = randomBytes(12); const cipher = createCipheriv('aes-256-gcm', this.key, iv);
        const ciphertext = Buffer.concat([cipher.update(JSON.stringify(value), 'utf8'), cipher.final()]);
        return Buffer.concat([iv, cipher.getAuthTag(), ciphertext]).toString('base64');
      }
      decrypt<T>(encoded: string): T {
        const bytes = Buffer.from(encoded, 'base64'); const decipher = createDecipheriv('aes-256-gcm', this.key, bytes.subarray(0, 12));
        decipher.setAuthTag(bytes.subarray(12, 28));
        return JSON.parse(Buffer.concat([decipher.update(bytes.subarray(28)), decipher.final()]).toString('utf8'));
      }
      get<T>(key: string): T | undefined { const value = this.store.setting(`secret:${key}`); return value ? this.decrypt<T>(value) : undefined; }
      set(key: string, value: unknown) { this.store.setSetting(`secret:${key}`, this.encrypt(value)); }
      remove(key: string) { this.store.run('DELETE FROM settings WHERE key=?', `secret:${key}`); }
    }

    const db = new DatabaseSync(join(config.dataDir, 'encore.sqlite'), { readOnly: true });
    const row: any = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM jobs WHERE id=?').get(id);
    assert.equal(row.status, 'needs_review'); assert.equal(row.done, 3940);
    const payload = JSON.parse(row.payload);
    const pending: any = db.prepare("SELECT seq,source_id FROM steps WHERE job_id=? AND status='pending' ORDER BY seq LIMIT 1").get(id);
    assert.equal(pending.seq, 3941);
    const source = JSON.parse(pending.source_id);
    const destination: any = db.prepare("SELECT target,expected FROM destinations WHERE account=? AND kind='playlist' AND source_id=?").get(payload.account, source.collectionId);
    const desired: string[] = payload.sequences[source.collectionId];
    assert.equal(desired.length, 122); assert.equal(source.destinationIndex, 100);
    assert.deepEqual(JSON.parse(destination.expected), desired.slice(0, 100));
    const vault = new Vault({ directory: config.dataDir, setting: (key: string) => (db.prepare('SELECT value FROM settings WHERE key=?').get(key) as any)?.value } as Store);
    const credentials = vault.get<YouTubeCredentials>('youtube')!;
    db.close();
    const { adapter } = await YouTubeAdapter.connect(credentials.cookie, credentials.accountIndex, credentials.channelId);
    assert.equal(adapter.identity, payload.account);
    const client = (adapter as any).client;
    async function entries() {
      let page = await client.music.getPlaylist(destination.target);
      const items: { videoId: string; setVideoId: string }[] = [];
      while (true) {
        for (const item of page.items || []) if (item.type !== 'ContinuationItem') items.push({ videoId: item.id, setVideoId: item.playlist_item_data?.playlist_set_video_id });
        if (!page.has_continuation) return items;
        page = await page.getContinuation();
      }
    }
    const before = await entries();
    assert.deepEqual(before.map(item => item.videoId), [...desired, ...desired.slice(100)]);
    assert.ok(before.every(item => item.setVideoId));
    assert.equal(new Set(before.map(item => item.setVideoId)).size, before.length);
    console.log('Verified exact repeated tail:', { intended: desired.length, actual: before.length, extra: before.length - desired.length, uniqueOccurrenceIds: true });
    if (process.argv.includes('--repair')) {
      const directory = join(config.dataDir, 'recovery'); await mkdir(directory, { recursive: true });
      const backup = join(directory, `repeated-tail-${id}-${Date.now()}.json`);
      await writeFile(backup, JSON.stringify({ jobId: id, playlist: destination.target, expected: desired, before, removed: before.slice(desired.length), capturedAt: new Date().toISOString() }, null, 2), { flag: 'wx' });
      assert.deepEqual(await entries(), before, 'Destination changed since inspection; repair cancelled.');
      const response = await client.actions.execute('/browse/edit_playlist', { client: 'YTMUSIC', parse: false, playlistId: destination.target,
        actions: before.slice(desired.length).map(item => ({ action: 'ACTION_REMOVE_VIDEO', setVideoId: item.setVideoId, removedVideoId: item.videoId })) });
      assert.ok(response.success && !response.data?.error); assert.equal(response.data?.status, 'STATUS_SUCCEEDED');
      for (let attempt = 0; attempt < 12; attempt++) {
        const after = await entries();
        if (after.length === desired.length) {
          assert.deepEqual(after, before.slice(0, desired.length));
          console.log('Repair verified: exactly 22 unintended tail occurrences removed; all 122 intended occurrences and their order preserved.');
          console.log('Recovery snapshot:', backup); process.exit(0);
        }
        await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 2000));

    ## Step 3 â€” Walk the Data Flow
    
    Trace the feature's data path from trigger to completion:
    
    1. **UI trigger** â€” What user action initiates the flow? (button click, page load, form submit)
    2. **Client â†’ Server** â€” What request is made? Check the fetch/action call, verify the URL, method, and payload match the API route
    3. **API route handler** â€” Read the route file. Does it handle the method? Does it validate input? Does it call the right service/database?
    4. **External dependencies** â€” If the route calls a database, third-party API, or Vercel service (KV, Blob, Postgres, AI SDK): verify the client is initialized, credentials are present, and the call shape matches the SDK docs
    5. **Response â†’ UI** â€” Does the response format match what the client expects? Is error handling present on both sides?
    
    At each boundary, check for these common breaks:
    - **Missing `await`** on async operations
    - **Wrong HTTP method** (GET handler but POST fetch)
    - **Env var absent** in runtime but present in `.env.local`
    - **Import mismatch** (server module imported in client component or vice versa)
    - **Type mismatch** between API response and client expectation
    - **Missing error boundary** â€” unhandled rejection crashes the page silently
    
    ## Step 4 â€” Report With Evidence
    
    Summarize findings in a structured report:
    
    ```
    ## Verification Report: [Feature Name]

    ### Flow Status
    | Boundary | Status | Evidence |
    |----------|--------|----------|
    | UI renders | âœ…/âŒ | [screenshot or console output] |
    | Client â†’ API | âœ…/âŒ | [request/response or error] |
    | API â†’ Data | âœ…/âŒ | [log output or error trace] |
    | Data â†’ Response | âœ…/âŒ | [response shape or error] |
    | Response â†’ UI | âœ…/âŒ | [rendered output or error] |
    
    ### Issues Found
    1. [Issue]: [evidence] â†’ [fix]
    
    ### Verified Working
    - [What was confirmed working with evidence]
    ```
    
    ## Stop Conditions
    
    **Stop verifying when**:
    - All boundaries in the flow are confirmed working with evidence â€” report success
    - You find the **first broken boundary** â€” report it with evidence and a specific fix, do not continue past the break
    - Two consecutive layers return no useful signal (e.g., no logs, no errors, no output) â€” flag the observability gap and recommend adding logging before continuing
    
    **Do not**:
    - Run the same check more than twice
    - Continue past a confirmed broken boundary
    - Verify unrelated features â€” stay on the inferred story
    - Spend time on cosmetic issues (styling, spacing) unless the user specifically asked
    
    ## Suggest Verification After Implementation
    
    When you finish building or implementing a feature (wrote code, created routes, set up a project), briefly let the user know they can ask you to verify everything works â€” e.g. browser verification or end-to-end flow check.     const base = 'http://127.0.0.1:8080';
    const id = 'c38a31f3-cde6-4bb6-afaa-1a909a152f10';
    const response = await fetch(`${base}/api/auth/status`);
    const session = await response.json();
    const headers = { cookie: response.headers.get('set-cookie')?.split(';')[0] || '', 'x-csrf-token': session.csrf };
    async function state() {
      const response = await fetch(`${base}/api/jobs`, { headers, signal: AbortSignal.timeout(10000) });
      if (!response.ok) throw new Error(`Could not read jobs: ${response.status}`);
      const jobs = (await response.json()).items;
      if (jobs.filter(job => job.kind === 'transfer').length !== 1) throw new Error('Transfer list changed. Inspect before resuming.');
      return jobs.find(job => job.id === id);
    }
    const before = await state();
    console.log('Saved checkpoint:', { status: before.status, done: before.done, failed: before.failed });
    if (before.status === 'needs_review' && before.done === 3940 && before.message.includes('Destination playlist changed outside this transfer.')) {
      const response = await fetch(`${base}/api/jobs/${id}/resume`, { method: 'POST', headers });
      if (!response.ok) throw new Error(`Resume failed: ${response.status}`);
      console.log('Resumed the same transfer.');
    } else if (!['queued', 'running'].includes(before.status)) throw new Error('Unexpected checkpoint. Left the transfer unchanged.');
    let last = '';
    for (let attempt = 0; attempt < 45; attempt++) {
      await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 2000));
      const job = await state(); const current = `${job.status}:${job.done}:${job.message}`;
      if (current !== last) { console.log('Transfer:', { status: job.status, done: job.done, skipped: job.skipped, failed: job.failed, message: job.message }); last = current; }
      if (job.failed) throw new Error('Transfer reported a failure. Inspect the report.');
      if (job.done > 4010 && ['running', 'completed', 'completed_with_issues'].includes(job.status)) { console.log('Verified: reconciled the repaired playlist and progressed through subsequent batches.'); break; }
      if (!['queued', 'running'].includes(job.status)) throw new Error('Transfer stopped before verification finished.');
    }

    export function Modal({ title, children, onClose }: { title: string; children: ReactNode; onClose: () => void }) {
      const ref = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
      const close = useRef(onClose); close.current = onClose;
      useEffect(() => {
        const previous = document.activeElement as HTMLElement | null;
        const overflow = document.body.style.overflow;
        document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
        ref.current?.focus();
        const key = (event: KeyboardEvent) => {
          if (event.key === 'Escape') close.current();
          if (event.key !== 'Tab') return;
          const items = [...(ref.current?.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>('button:not(:disabled),input:not(:disabled),textarea:not(:disabled),select,summary,a[href]') || [])].filter(item => item.getClientRects().length);
          if (!items.length) { event.preventDefault(); return; }
          if (event.shiftKey && (document.activeElement === items[0] || document.activeElement === ref.current)) { event.preventDefault(); items.at(-1)?.focus(); }
          else if (!event.shiftKey && document.activeElement === items.at(-1)) { event.preventDefault(); items[0].focus(); }
        };
        document.addEventListener('keydown', key);
        return () => { document.removeEventListener('keydown', key); document.body.style.overflow = overflow; previous?.focus(); };
      }, []);
      return <div className="modal-backdrop" onMouseDown={event => { if (event.target === event.currentTarget) onClose(); }}>
        <div className="modal" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-label={title} tabIndex={-1} ref={ref}>
          <div className="modal-heading"><h2>{title}</h2><button className="icon-button" aria-label="Close dialog" onClick={onClose}><X size={20}/></button></div>
          {children}
        </div>

    import { Store, now } from './store.js';
    
    const conflict = (message: string) => Object.assign(new Error(message), { statusCode: 409 });
    
    export function skipFailedTransferSteps(store: Store, id: string) {
      return store.transaction(() => {
        const job = store.getJob(id);
        if (!job) throw Object.assign(new Error('Job not found.'), { statusCode: 404 });
        if (job.kind !== 'transfer') throw conflict('Only music transfers support skipping failed actions.');
        if (['queued', 'running', 'cancelled', 'completed'].includes(job.status)) throw conflict('Pause the transfer before skipping failed actions.');
        const unfinished = store.all("SELECT seq,kind,source_id,status,reason FROM steps WHERE job_id=? AND status IN ('pending','failed') ORDER BY seq", id);
        const failed = unfinished.filter(step => step.status === 'failed');
        if (!failed.length) throw conflict('This transfer has no failed actions to skip.');
        const playlists = new Set<string>();
        for (const step of failed) {
          const source = JSON.parse(step.source_id);
          if (step.kind === 'playlist') playlists.add(source.id);
          if (step.kind === 'playlist_item') playlists.add(source.collectionId);
        }
        let skipped = 0;
        for (const step of unfinished) {
          const related = step.kind === 'playlist_item' && playlists.has(JSON.parse(step.source_id).collectionId);
          if (step.status !== 'failed' && !related) continue;
          const reason = step.status === 'failed'
            ? `Skipped by owner after failure. ${step.reason || ''}`.trim()
            : 'Skipped by owner because this playlist has a failed action. Other playlists and library actions can continue.';
          store.run("UPDATE steps SET status='skipped',reason=? WHERE job_id=? AND seq=?", reason, id, step.seq);
          skipped++;
        }
        // Keep completed actions, source selections, destination mappings, and write
        // intents intact. Skipping never edits or removes music already on YouTube.
        const counts = store.get("SELECT SUM(status='done') done,SUM(status='failed') failed,SUM(status='skipped') skipped,SUM(status='pending') pending FROM steps WHERE job_id=?", id)!;
        store.run("UPDATE jobs SET done=?,failed=?,skipped=?,status=?,message=?,payload=json_remove(payload,'$.nextCheck'),updated=? WHERE id=?",
          counts.done || 0, counts.failed || 0, counts.skipped || 0, counts.pending ? 'queued' : 'completed_with_issues',
          `${skipped} failed or related actions skipped. ${counts.pending ? 'Continuing with the remaining music.' : 'Transfer finished with skipped actions.'}`, now(), id);
        return store.getJob(id)!;
      });
    }

    import { test } from 'node:test';
    import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
    import { createApp } from '../server/app.js';
    import { createTransfer } from '../server/worker.js';
    import { skipFailedTransferSteps } from '../server/job-actions.js';
    import { Store } from '../server/store.js';
    import { ProviderError } from '../server/youtube.js';
    import { FakeMusic, temporaryDirectory } from './helpers.js';
    
    const selection = { collectionIds: [] as string[], likes: false, songs: false, albums: false, artists: false, favoriteIds: [] as string[] };
    function song(store: Store, name: string) {
      const id = store.entity({ kind: 'song', name, artists: ['Artist'], liked: true, saved: true });
      store.run("UPDATE entities SET status='matched',target=? WHERE id=?", JSON.stringify({ id: name, name, artists: ['Artist'], url: `https://music.youtube.com/watch?v=${name}` }), id);
      return id;
    }
    
    test('skip failed creation skips its tracks and continues other playlists, likes, and saves through the API', async () => {
      const temp = await temporaryDirectory(); const provider = new FakeMusic();
      const create = provider.createPlaylist.bind(provider);
      provider.createPlaylist = async (name, description) => { if (name === 'Broken') throw new ProviderError('Playlist creation rejected.', 400); return create(name, description); };
      const { app, store, worker } = await createApp({ dataDir: temp.directory, providerFactory: async () => provider, startWorker: false });
      (worker as any).wait = async () => {};
      try {
        const first = song(store, 'First'); const second = song(store, 'Second');
        const broken = store.collection('broken', { name: 'Broken', description: '' }, [first, second]);
        const good = store.collection('good', { name: 'Good', description: '' }, [first]);
        const job = createTransfer(store, { ...selection, collectionIds: [broken, good], likes: true, songs: true }, provider.identity);
        await worker.tick();
        assert.equal(store.getJob(job.id)!.status, 'needs_review'); assert.equal(store.getJob(job.id)!.failed, 1);
        const session = await app.inject({ url: '/api/auth/status' });
        const cookie = String(session.headers['set-cookie']).split(';')[0];
        const headers = { cookie, 'x-csrf-token': session.json().csrf };
        const url = `/api/jobs/${job.id}/skip-failed`;
        assert.equal((await app.inject({ method: 'POST', url, headers: { cookie } })).statusCode, 403);
        const result = await app.inject({ method: 'POST', url, headers });
        assert.equal(result.statusCode, 200, result.body);
        assert.equal(result.json().status, 'queued'); assert.equal(result.json().failed, 0); assert.equal(result.json().skipped, 3);
        assert.equal(result.json().total, job.total); assert.deepEqual(result.json().summary, job.summary);
        assert.equal((await app.inject({ method: 'POST', url, headers })).statusCode, 409, 'Repeated clicks cannot skip more actions');
        await worker.tick();
        assert.equal(store.getJob(job.id)!.status, 'completed_with_issues'); assert.equal(store.getJob(job.id)!.failed, 0);
        assert.deepEqual([...provider.playlists.values()].map(playlist => playlist.ids), [['First']]);
        assert.deepEqual([...provider.likes].sort(), ['First', 'Second']); assert.deepEqual([...provider.songs].sort(), ['First', 'Second']);
        const report = (await app.inject({ url: `/api/jobs/${job.id}/report?format=json`, headers })).json();
        assert.equal(report.items.filter((item: any) => item.status === 'skipped').length, 3);
        assert.match(report.items[0].reason, /Playlist creation rejected/);
        assert.equal(store.get("SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM jobs WHERE kind='transfer'")!.n, 1);
      } finally { await app.close(); await temp.cleanup(); }
    });
    
    test('skip failed playlist entry preserves completed entries, prior skips, and an uncertain write checkpoint', async () => {
      const temp = await temporaryDirectory(); const store = new Store(temp.directory);
      try {
        const first = song(store, 'First'); const second = song(store, 'Second');
        const playlist = store.collection('partial', { name: 'Partially transferred', description: '' }, [first, second, first, second]);
        const other = store.collection('other', { name: 'Other playlist', description: '' }, [first]);
        const job = createTransfer(store, { ...selection, collectionIds: [playlist, other], likes: true }, '@owner');
        store.stepResult(job.id, 0, 'done', 'Created.', 'https://music.youtube.com/playlist?list=existing');
        store.stepResult(job.id, 1, 'done', 'Already transferred.', 'https://music.youtube.com/watch?v=First');
        store.stepResult(job.id, 2, 'failed', 'Recording rejected.');
        store.stepResult(job.id, 3, 'skipped', 'A previous explicit skip.');
        store.setSetting('playlist-append:fixture', JSON.stringify({ jobId: job.id, start: 1, end: 2 }));
        store.run("UPDATE jobs SET payload=json_set(payload,'$.nextCheck',?) WHERE id=?", Date.now() + 60000, job.id);
        store.updateJob(job.id, 'needs_review');
        const completed = store.all("SELECT * FROM steps WHERE job_id=? AND status='done'", job.id);
        const result = skipFailedTransferSteps(store, job.id);
        assert.equal(result.status, 'queued'); assert.equal(result.done, 2); assert.equal(result.failed, 0); assert.equal(result.skipped, 3);
        assert.deepEqual(store.all("SELECT * FROM steps WHERE job_id=? AND status='done'", job.id), completed);
        assert.equal(store.get('SELECT reason FROM steps WHERE job_id=? AND seq=3', job.id)!.reason, 'A previous explicit skip.');
        assert.equal(store.get('SELECT status FROM steps WHERE job_id=? AND seq=4', job.id)!.status, 'skipped');
        assert.ok(store.all("SELECT * FROM steps WHERE job_id=? AND seq>4", job.id).every(step => step.status === 'pending'));
        assert.ok(store.setting('playlist-append:fixture'), 'An uncertain remote write remains recorded');
        assert.equal(JSON.parse(store.get('SELECT payload FROM jobs WHERE id=?', job.id)!.payload).nextCheck, undefined);
        const counts = store.get("SELECT SUM(status='pending') n FROM steps WHERE job_id=?", job.id)!.n;
        assert.equal(result.done + result.skipped + result.failed + counts, result.total);
      } finally { store.close(); await temp.cleanup(); }
    });
    
    test('a failed library action skips only that action and finishes when nothing remains', async () => {
      const temp = await temporaryDirectory(); const store = new Store(temp.directory);
      try {
        song(store, 'First');
        const job = createTransfer(store, { ...selection, likes: true, songs: true }, '@owner');
        store.stepResult(job.id, 0, 'done', 'Liked.'); store.stepResult(job.id, 1, 'failed', 'Save rejected.');
        store.updateJob(job.id, 'completed_with_issues');
        const result = skipFailedTransferSteps(store, job.id);
        assert.equal(result.status, 'completed_with_issues'); assert.equal(result.done, 1); assert.equal(result.skipped, 1); assert.equal(result.failed, 0);
      } finally { store.close(); await temp.cleanup(); }
    });
    
    test('active jobs, cancelled jobs, non-transfer jobs, and jobs without failures cannot be skipped', async () => {
      const temp = await temporaryDirectory(); const store = new Store(temp.directory);
      try {
        const job = store.job('transfer', {}, [{ kind: 'like', sourceId: '{}' }]); store.stepResult(job.id, 0, 'failed', 'Rejected.');
        for (const status of ['queued', 'running', 'cancelled', 'completed'] as const) {
          store.updateJob(job.id, status);
          assert.throws(() => skipFailedTransferSteps(store, job.id), (error: any) => error.statusCode === 409);
          assert.equal(store.getJob(job.id)!.failed, 1);
        }
        const matching = store.job('match', {}, [{ kind: 'match', sourceId: 'entity' }]); store.stepResult(matching.id, 0, 'failed'); store.updateJob(matching.id, 'failed');
        assert.throws(() => skipFailedTransferSteps(store, matching.id), (error: any) => error.statusCode === 409);
        store.updateJob(job.id, 'paused'); store.stepResult(job.id, 0, 'done');
        assert.throws(() => skipFailedTransferSteps(store, job.id), (error: any) => error.statusCode === 409);
        assert.throws(() => skipFailedTransferSteps(store, 'unknown'), (error: any) => error.statusCode === 404);
      } finally { store.close(); await temp.cleanup(); }
    });

      assert.equal(await page.evaluate(() => document.documentElement.scrollWidth <= innerWidth), true, 'Transfer controls fit on mobile');
      await page.screenshot({ path: 'tmp/skip-failed-mobile.png', fullPage: true });
      const result = page.waitForResponse((response: any) => response.url().endsWith(`/api/jobs/${job.id}/skip-failed`) && response.request().method() === 'POST');
      await skip.click();
      const response = await result; assert.equal(response.status(), 200);
      const body = await response.json(); assert.equal(body.status, 'queued'); assert.equal(body.failed, 0); assert.equal(body.skipped, 3);
      await worker.tick();
      await page.locator('.badge.completed_with_issues').waitFor({ timeout: 15000 });
      assert.equal(await skip.count(), 0);
      assert.match(await page.locator('.job-counts').innerText(), /3 skipped[\s\S]*0 failed/);
      assert.deepEqual([...provider.playlists.values()].map(playlist => playlist.ids), [['video']]);
      assert.deepEqual(errors, []);
      console.log('Browser → skip API → dependency skips → same-job continuation passed. Button works on mobile; unrelated playlist completed and failed details remain in report.');
    } finally { if (browser) await browser.close(); await app.close(); await temp.cleanup(); }
